entries.shortAnswer: 「电子红包」的英文是 digital red envelope，指通过微信、支付宝等平台发送的线上现金红包。
entries.definition: digital red envelope 指线上发放的现金红包；常见搭配：send / snatch a digital red envelope（发/抢电子红包）。

examples.en: During the Spring Festival, I sent my parents a digital red envelope through WeChat.
examples.zh: 春节期间，我通过微信给父母发了一个电子红包。

examples.en: She snatched a digital red envelope in the group chat and immediately used the money to scan to pay at the supermarket.
examples.zh: 她在群聊里抢到了一个电子红包，随后立刻用这笔钱在超市扫码支付。

entries.shortAnswer: “digital red envelope”的中文意思是「电子红包」，指通过微信、支付宝等平台发送的线上现金红包，常用于春节。
entries.definition: digital red envelope 指线上发放的现金红包，常见搭配：send / receive / snatch a digital red envelope。

examples.en: During the Spring Festival, I sent my parents a digital red envelope through WeChat.
examples.zh: 春节期间，我通过微信给父母发了一个电子红包。

examples.en: She snatched a digital red envelope in the group chat and immediately used the money to scan to pay at the supermarket.
examples.zh: 她在群聊里抢到了一个电子红包，随后立刻用这笔钱在超市扫码支付。

entries.shortAnswer: 「提现」的英文是 withdraw cash，指把账户余额取出为现金或转到银行卡，常用于移动支付和银行场景。注意与「转账 transfer」和「付款 pay」区分，提现是取钱而非付钱。
entries.definition: withdraw cash 强调提取现金。在移动支付中，提现常指把钱包余额转到银行卡，英文可说 withdraw cash to a bank card 或 cash out。名词形式是 withdrawal，如 make a withdrawal。

examples.en: You can withdraw cash from the app to your bank card, usually within one business day.
examples.zh: 你可以把应用里的钱提现到银行卡，通常一个工作日内到账。

examples.en: If you need cash, withdraw cash at an ATM instead of using a payment QR code.
examples.zh: 如果你需要现金，就在自动取款机提现，而不是用付款码支付。

entries.shortAnswer: 「withdraw cash」的中文意思是「提现」，即把账户里的钱取出为现金或转到银行卡。它强调取钱，与「转账 transfer」不同，也与「付款 pay」方向相反。
entries.definition: withdraw cash 核心是提取现金，常见搭配 withdraw cash from an ATM/bank account。在移动支付里，也常指把电子钱包余额提现到银行卡，可译作 cash out。名词是 withdrawal。

examples.en: You can withdraw cash from the app to your bank card, usually within one business day.
examples.zh: 你可以把应用里的钱提现到银行卡，通常一个工作日内到账。

examples.en: If you need cash, withdraw cash at an ATM instead of using a payment QR code.
examples.zh: 如果你需要现金，就在自动取款机提现，而不是用付款码支付。

entries.shortAnswer: 「付款码」的英文是 payment QR code，指用户在手机上生成、向商家出示以供扫码扣款的二维码。
entries.definition: payment QR code 即「付款码」，用户出示给商家扫描扣款，方向与商家展示的收款码相反。

examples.en: At the checkout, just open the app and show your payment QR code to the cashier.
examples.zh: 结账时，打开应用，把付款码出示给收银员看即可。

examples.en: The store's scanner beeped after I held up my payment QR code, and the money was deducted instantly.
examples.zh: 我把付款码举起来后，店里的扫码器响了一声，钱立刻就被扣掉了。

entries.shortAnswer: Payment QR code is 付款码 in Chinese: a code on your phone shown to a merchant to scan and charge you.
entries.definition: A payment QR code is 付款码: a code customers show at checkout so the merchant can scan and charge the linked account.

examples.en: At the checkout, just open the app and show your payment QR code to the cashier.
examples.zh: 结账时，打开应用，把付款码出示给收银员看即可。

examples.en: The store's scanner beeped after I held up my payment QR code, and the money was deducted instantly.
examples.zh: 我把付款码举起来后，店里的扫码器响了一声，钱立刻就被扣掉了。

entries.shortAnswer: 「余额」的英文是 account balance，指账户里剩余可用的钱，常用于银行与移动支付场景。
entries.definition: account balance 多指账户余额，口语中可省略 account。常见搭配：check、top up、remaining balance。

examples.en: I checked my account balance before scanning the QR code to pay.
examples.zh: 扫码付款前，我先查了一下账户余额。

examples.en: After the refund was returned to my original payment method, my account balance went up.
examples.zh: 退款原路退回后，我的账户余额增加了。

entries.shortAnswer: 「account balance」的中文意思是「余额」，即账户中剩余可用的金额，常见于银行与移动支付场景。
entries.definition: account balance 指银行或支付账户的可用余额，常见搭配有 check、top up、remaining balance。

examples.en: I checked my account balance before scanning the QR code to pay.
examples.zh: 扫码付款前，我先查了一下账户余额。

examples.en: After the refund was returned to my original payment method, my account balance went up.
examples.zh: 退款原路退回后，我的账户余额增加了。

entries.shortAnswer: 微信支付的英文是 WeChat Pay；付款时请说 pay with WeChat Pay，别写成 Weixin Pay。
entries.definition: 微信支付指微信内的扫码付款、付款码、转账与自动续费，如 scan to pay、refund 原路退回。

examples.en: At the checkout, I just scanned the QR code and paid with WeChat Pay.
examples.zh: 结账时，我扫了一下二维码，用微信支付付了款。

examples.en: If the item is out of stock, the refund will go back to your WeChat Pay account in a few days.
examples.zh: 如果商品缺货，退款会在几天内原路退回到你的微信支付账户。

entries.shortAnswer: 「微信支付」in English is WeChat Pay, Tencent's mobile payment service inside WeChat.
entries.definition: WeChat Pay is used for scan-to-pay, payment QR codes, transfers, and auto-renewal; say pay with WeChat Pay, not Weixin Pay.

examples.en: At the checkout, I just scanned the QR code and paid with WeChat Pay.
examples.zh: 结账时，我扫了一下二维码，用微信支付付了款。

examples.en: If the item is out of stock, the refund will go back to your WeChat Pay account in a few days.
examples.zh: 如果商品缺货，退款会在几天内原路退回到你的微信支付账户。

entries.shortAnswer: 「扫码支付」的英文是 scan to pay，指用手机扫二维码付款；作定语时常用 scan-to-pay。
entries.definition: scan to pay 是动词短语，用于移动支付，如 customers can scan to pay here。名词形式可用 QR code payment。注意：向商家出示付款码是 show a payment QR code，方向相反。

examples.en: You can scan to pay at the counter, or just show your payment QR code to the cashier.
examples.zh: 你可以在柜台扫码支付，或者直接向收银员出示付款码。

examples.en: After the refund, the money goes back to your account by the original payment method, so the scan to pay record still shows the order.
examples.zh: 退款后，钱会按原路退回到你的账户，所以那笔扫码支付记录仍会显示该订单。

entries.shortAnswer: scan to pay 的中文意思是「扫码支付」，即用手机扫二维码完成付款，强调扫码动作，与泛指的 mobile payment 不同。
entries.definition: scan to pay 多用于口语和商业提示，如 scan to pay here；正式文本可用 QR code payment。注意：向商家出示付款码应说 show a payment QR code，而非 scan to pay。

examples.en: You can scan to pay at the counter, or just show your payment QR code to the cashier.
examples.zh: 你可以在柜台扫码支付，或者直接向收银员出示付款码。

examples.en: After the refund, the money goes back to your account by the original payment method, so the scan to pay record still shows the order.
examples.zh: 退款后，钱会按原路退回到你的账户，所以那笔扫码支付记录仍会显示该订单。

entries.shortAnswer: 「花呗」的英文是 Huabei credit。它不是花，是支付宝的“先消费后还款”信用服务，类似 BNPL。
entries.definition: Huabei credit 是蚂蚁集团旗下消费信贷产品，本质为虚拟信用额度，支持先消费后还款，常用于线上购物和扫码支付。不要译成 flower shell。

examples.en: When paying with Alipay, you can choose Huabei credit to buy now and pay later.
examples.zh: 用支付宝付款时，你可以选择花呗，先消费后还款。

examples.en: If you use Huabei credit for your purchase, the refund will go back to your Huabei credit account.
examples.zh: 如果你用花呗付款，退款将原路退回你的花呗账户。

entries.shortAnswer: “Huabei credit”的中文意思是「花呗」。它是支付宝的消费信贷服务，不是普通信用卡，类似 BNPL。
entries.definition: Huabei credit 指蚂蚁集团提供的“先消费后还款”信用支付服务，常用于支付宝扫码支付和线上购物，可分期或延期还款，与普通信用卡不同。

examples.en: When paying with Alipay, you can choose Huabei credit to buy now and pay later.
examples.zh: 用支付宝付款时，你可以选择花呗，先消费后还款。

examples.en: If you use Huabei credit for your purchase, the refund will go back to your Huabei credit account.
examples.zh: 如果你用花呗付款，退款将原路退回你的花呗账户。

entries.shortAnswer: 「绑定银行卡」的英文是 link a bank card，用于支付应用添加支付方式。
entries.definition: link a bank card 指将银行卡与支付账户关联，用于扣款或退款。常见搭配：link a card to WeChat Pay。注意不用 bind。

examples.en: To use scan to pay, you first need to link a bank card in the app.
examples.zh: 要使用扫码支付，你需要先在应用里绑定银行卡。

examples.en: If you link a bank card, refunds will go back to the original payment method automatically.
examples.zh: 如果你绑定了银行卡，退款会自动原路退回。

entries.shortAnswer: 「link a bank card」的中文意思是绑定银行卡，即把银行卡添加到支付账户。
entries.definition: link a bank card 指将银行卡与支付账户关联以便扣款。常见搭配：link a bank card to Alipay。注意 link 后接 to，不用 bind。

examples.en: To use scan to pay, you first need to link a bank card in the app.
examples.zh: 要使用扫码支付，你需要先在应用里绑定银行卡。

examples.en: If you link a bank card, refunds will go back to the original payment method automatically.
examples.zh: 如果你绑定了银行卡，退款会自动原路退回。

entries.shortAnswer: 「免密支付」的英文是 password-free payment，指小额交易无需密码即可扣款。
entries.definition: 免密支付 = password-free payment，核心是小额免验证扣款，常配自动续费、代扣协议。

examples.en: I enabled password-free payment for my transit card so I can tap and ride the subway without entering a PIN.
examples.zh: 我为公交卡开通了免密支付，这样坐地铁时刷卡即可，无需输入密码。

examples.en: Many bike-sharing apps use password-free payment to automatically deduct the fare after each ride.
examples.zh: 许多共享单车应用使用免密支付，在每次骑行后自动扣费。

entries.shortAnswer: 「password-free payment」的中文意思是「免密支付」，即小额支付无需输入密码。
entries.definition: password-free payment 指免密支付，常见搭配 set up / enable password-free payment。

examples.en: I enabled password-free payment for my transit card so I can tap and ride the subway without entering a PIN.
examples.zh: 我为公交卡开通了免密支付，这样坐地铁时刷卡即可，无需输入密码。

examples.en: Many bike-sharing apps use password-free payment to automatically deduct the fare after each ride.
examples.zh: 许多共享单车应用使用免密支付，在每次骑行后自动扣费。

entries.shortAnswer: 「二维码收款」的英文是 QR code payment，指用扫码方式完成收付款。
entries.definition: QR code payment 是移动支付的总称，涵盖扫码付款与扫码收款。常见搭配：accept QR code payment 接受二维码收款。

examples.en: This small shop now accepts QR code payment, so you do not need to carry cash.
examples.zh: 这家小店现在支持二维码收款，所以你不用带现金了。

examples.en: If the QR code payment fails, the refund will go back to your original payment method.
examples.zh: 如果二维码收款失败，退款会原路退回到你的原支付方式。

entries.shortAnswer: QR code payment 的中文意思是「二维码收款」，即通过扫码完成交易。
entries.definition: QR code payment 指用二维码完成的收付款，商家收款和顾客付款都算。常说 accept QR code payments、pay by QR code。

examples.en: This small shop now accepts QR code payment, so you do not need to carry cash.
examples.zh: 这家小店现在支持二维码收款，所以你不用带现金了。

examples.en: If the QR code payment fails, the refund will go back to your original payment method.
examples.zh: 如果二维码收款失败，退款会原路退回到你的原支付方式。

entries.shortAnswer: 「拼手气红包」的英文是 lucky red envelope。它专指微信群里金额随机分配的抢红包玩法，抢到最多的人常被称为「手气王」。
entries.definition: 拼手气红包指微信群内金额随机分配的互动红包。常见搭配：发拼手气红包 send a lucky red envelope、手气最佳 get the luckiest draw。注意它重在社交娱乐，金额通常不大。

examples.en: The group chat went crazy when the manager sent a lucky red envelope during the break.
examples.zh: 休息时经理在群里发了一个拼手气红包，群里一下子热闹起来。

examples.en: I only got a few cents from the lucky red envelope, but the fun was in the competition.
examples.zh: 这个拼手气红包我只抢到几分钱，但乐趣就在于大家比拼手气。

entries.shortAnswer: Lucky red envelope 的中文意思是「拼手气红包」。它特指微信群中金额随机分配的抢红包玩法，不是所有红包都叫这个。
entries.definition: Lucky red envelope 指微信群里随机分金额的娱乐红包，口语常说 grab a lucky red envelope。与普通 red envelope 不同，它强调随机分配和社交互动，金额一般不大。

examples.en: The group chat went crazy when the manager sent a lucky red envelope during the break.
examples.zh: 休息时经理在群里发了一个拼手气红包，群里一下子热闹起来。

examples.en: I only got a few cents from the lucky red envelope, but the fun was in the competition.
examples.zh: 这个拼手气红包我只抢到几分钱，但乐趣就在于大家比拼手气。

entries.shortAnswer: “转账到账”的英文是 transfer arrival，指款项已成功进入收款账户，常在移动支付状态提示中出现。
entries.definition: transfer arrival 指转账完成并入账，常见于银行 App 和支付状态提示，强调款项已到达收款账户并可用。

examples.en: You will get a notification once the transfer arrival is confirmed by the bank.
examples.zh: 银行确认转账到账后，你会收到通知。

examples.en: The transfer arrival usually takes a few minutes for mobile payments.
examples.zh: 移动支付通常几分钟即可转账到账。

entries.shortAnswer: “transfer arrival”的中文意思是“转账到账”，指款项已进入收款账户，常用于移动支付状态提示。
entries.definition: transfer arrival means the money has reached the recipient account, common in banking and payment status notices.

examples.en: You will get a notification once the transfer arrival is confirmed by the bank.
examples.zh: 银行确认转账到账后，你会收到通知。

examples.en: The transfer arrival usually takes a few minutes for mobile payments.
examples.zh: 移动支付通常几分钟即可转账到账。

entries.shortAnswer: 「收款码」的英文是 payment code sign，指商家展示给顾客扫描的二维码。它和顾客出示的付款码（payment QR code）方向相反，别搞混。
entries.definition: payment code sign 多用于移动支付场景，指商家张贴或展示、供顾客扫码付款的二维码。易错点：向商家出示的是付款码，英文常说 payment QR code；收款码是商家收钱用的。

examples.en: The vendor pointed at the payment code sign on the counter and asked me to scan it.
examples.zh: 摊主指了指柜台上的收款码，让我扫一下。

examples.en: Please display your payment code sign near the cashier so customers can pay more quickly.
examples.zh: 请把收款码摆放在收银台附近，方便顾客更快付款。

entries.shortAnswer: payment code sign 的中文意思是「收款码」，是商家向顾客展示、用于收款的二维码。它和顾客向商家出示的付款码方向相反。
entries.definition: payment code sign 指商家展示的收款二维码，常见搭配 display a payment code sign、scan the payment code sign。多用于扫码支付 scan to pay 场景，口语中也可说 merchant QR code。

examples.en: The vendor pointed at the payment code sign on the counter and asked me to scan it.
examples.zh: 摊主指了指柜台上的收款码，让我扫一下。

examples.en: Please display your payment code sign near the cashier so customers can pay more quickly.
examples.zh: 请把收款码摆放在收银台附近，方便顾客更快付款。

entries.shortAnswer: 「自动续费」的英文是 auto-renewal subscription，指订阅到期后系统自动扣款续期。注意不要直译成 automatic continue fee。
entries.definition: 核心义为按周期自动扣款的订阅，常见搭配 set up / cancel / turn off auto-renewal subscription。多用于 App Store、流媒体、会员制等场景。易错点：不能简单理解为一次性付款。

examples.en: I forgot to cancel my auto-renewal subscription, so the app charged me again this month.
examples.zh: 我忘了取消自动续费，所以这个月这个应用又扣了我一次钱。

examples.en: You can turn off the auto-renewal subscription in your payment settings before the free trial ends.
examples.zh: 你可以在免费试用结束前，在支付设置里关闭自动续费。

entries.shortAnswer: auto-renewal subscription 的中文意思是「自动续费」，指订阅服务到期后自动扣款并延长使用期限。它强调续期扣款，不同于泛指定期扣款的 recurring payment。
entries.definition: 核心义为按周期自动扣款的订阅，常见搭配 set up / cancel / turn off auto-renewal subscription。多用于 App Store、流媒体、会员制等场景。易错点：不能简单理解为一次性付款。

examples.en: I forgot to cancel my auto-renewal subscription, so the app charged me again this month.
examples.zh: 我忘了取消自动续费，所以这个月这个应用又扣了我一次钱。

examples.en: You can turn off the auto-renewal subscription in your payment settings before the free trial ends.
examples.zh: 你可以在免费试用结束前，在支付设置里关闭自动续费。

entries.shortAnswer: 「记账」的英文是 track expenses，指持续记录每笔收支与花费，不只是数钱。
entries.definition: track expenses 意为持续记录花费，常用搭配 track daily expenses、track expenses in an app；区别于 count money。

examples.en: I use an app to track expenses, especially scan-to-pay and auto-renewal charges.
examples.zh: 我用应用记账，尤其是扫码支付和自动续费扣款。

examples.en: If you track expenses carefully, you can spot refunds that don't return to your payment method.
examples.zh: 如果认真记账，就能发现没有原路退回的退款。

entries.shortAnswer: Track expenses means 记账 in Chinese: recording spending over time, not just counting cash.
entries.definition: Track expenses means to keep a record of spending. Say track expenses monthly, track expenses in an app. Not the same as count money.

examples.en: I use an app to track expenses, especially scan-to-pay and auto-renewal charges.
examples.zh: 我用应用记账，尤其是扫码支付和自动续费扣款。

examples.en: If you track expenses carefully, you can spot refunds that don't return to your payment method.
examples.zh: 如果认真记账，就能发现没有原路退回的退款。

entries.shortAnswer: AA收款英文是 split the bill request，指在群里发起让大家按人均摊付款的请求。
entries.definition: 向多人发起、每人分摊金额的收款请求，类似 Venmo request；注意与商家收款码区分。

examples.en: I sent a split the bill request to the group chat after dinner so everyone could pay their share.
examples.zh: 吃完饭后我在群里发起了AA收款，这样每个人都能付自己那一份。

examples.en: If you use the app, you can create a split the bill request and each friend gets a notification to pay.
examples.zh: 如果你用这个应用，可以创建一笔AA收款，每位朋友都会收到一条付款通知。

entries.shortAnswer: AA收款 in Chinese is a split the bill request, asking a group to each pay a share.
entries.definition: A payment app request sent to several people so each pays an equal share, as on Venmo.

examples.en: I sent a split the bill request to the group chat after dinner so everyone could pay their share.
examples.zh: 吃完饭后我在群里发起了AA收款，这样每个人都能付自己那一份。

examples.en: If you use the app, you can create a split the bill request and each friend gets a notification to pay.
examples.zh: 如果你用这个应用，可以创建一笔AA收款，每位朋友都会收到一条付款通知。

entries.shortAnswer: 资金冻结的英文是payment hold，指支付平台或银行暂时扣留款项。注意：常与chargeback不同，chargeback是持卡人发起拒付，而payment hold多为平台风控或待清算。
entries.definition: payment hold常见于移动支付：提现、退款、收款码进账都可能被hold。搭配：place/put a hold on funds。注意资金冻结≠账户封禁，hold解除后资金可原路退回。

examples.en: The payment platform placed a payment hold on my withdrawal because of a risk review.
examples.zh: 支付平台因风控审核对我的提现做了资金冻结。

examples.en: If you request a refund, the seller may release the payment hold within three to five business days.
examples.zh: 如果你申请退款，卖家可能在三到五个工作日内解除资金冻结。

entries.shortAnswer: payment hold的中文意思是资金冻结，指支付平台暂时不释放款项。语义要点：hold强调暂时性冻结，区别于永久性forfeiture或chargeback。
entries.definition: payment hold指平台或银行暂时扣留资金，常见搭配：place a hold on, release the hold。口语中说my money is on hold。易错：hold≠扣款，解除后可原路退回。

examples.en: The payment platform placed a payment hold on my withdrawal because of a risk review.
examples.zh: 支付平台因风控审核对我的提现做了资金冻结。

examples.en: If you request a refund, the seller may release the payment hold within three to five business days.
examples.zh: 如果你申请退款，卖家可能在三到五个工作日内解除资金冻结。

entries.shortAnswer: 「支付失败」的英文是 payment failed，常见于扫码或付款码支付后页面提示，整句说 The payment failed。
entries.definition: payment failed 指交易未完成，常见搭配：The payment failed, please try again。余额不足或网络异常都可能触发该提示。

examples.en: The payment failed, so please scan the payment QR code again to retry.
examples.zh: 支付失败了，请重新扫描付款码再试一次。

examples.en: If the payment failed because of insufficient balance, you can switch to BNPL and pay next month.
examples.zh: 如果支付失败是因为余额不足，你可以改用花呗，下个月再还款。

entries.shortAnswer: payment failed 的中文意思是「支付失败」，即付款未成功。它强调交易结果，不等于 payment declined。
entries.definition: payment failed 用于扫码或付款码支付后提示失败，常见搭配：payment failed, please try again。口语也说 didn't go through。

examples.en: The payment failed, so please scan the payment QR code again to retry.
examples.zh: 支付失败了，请重新扫描付款码再试一次。

examples.en: If the payment failed because of insufficient balance, you can switch to BNPL and pay next month.
examples.zh: 如果支付失败是因为余额不足，你可以改用花呗，下个月再还款。

entries.shortAnswer: 「退款原路退回」英文说 refund to original payment，指钱款返回原付款渠道，不是转余额。
entries.definition: 移动支付常用说法，强调退回原渠道，常见搭配 issue a refund to original payment。

examples.en: If you cancel the subscription within seven days, we will issue a refund to original payment.
examples.zh: 如果你在七天内取消订阅，我们会按退款原路退回处理。

examples.en: She chose a refund to original payment instead of store credit.
examples.zh: 她选择退款原路退回，而不是退成店铺余额。

entries.shortAnswer: refund to original payment 就是「退款原路退回」，指钱沿原付款渠道返回，而非转成余额。
entries.definition: Common in mobile payments and e-commerce: issue/request a refund to original payment method.

examples.en: If you cancel the subscription within seven days, we will issue a refund to original payment.
examples.zh: 如果你在七天内取消订阅，我们会按退款原路退回处理。

examples.en: She chose a refund to original payment instead of store credit.
examples.zh: 她选择退款原路退回，而不是退成店铺余额。

entries.shortAnswer: 「支付密码」的英文是 payment password；在移动支付中，它常指确认付款或提现时输入的密码，和登录密码不是一回事。
entries.definition: payment password 多指扫码付款、提现或修改支付设置时验证身份用的密码，通常区别于登录密码。常见搭配：enter your payment password（输入支付密码）、reset payment password（重置支付密码）。

examples.en: Please enter your payment password to complete the scan-to-pay transaction.
examples.zh: 请输入支付密码以完成扫码支付交易。

examples.en: If you forget your payment password, you can reset it through the app before withdrawing cash.
examples.zh: 如果你忘记支付密码，可以在提现前通过应用重置。

entries.shortAnswer: “payment password”的中文意思是「支付密码」，常用于扫码付款、提现或确认支付时验证身份；它和 login password（登录密码）不同。
entries.definition: payment password 指移动支付中用于确认交易、提现或安全验证的密码，比登录密码更偏向资金操作。常见搭配：enter your payment password、forgot payment password、set a payment password。

examples.en: Please enter your payment password to complete the scan-to-pay transaction.
examples.zh: 请输入支付密码以完成扫码支付交易。

examples.en: If you forget your payment password, you can reset it through the app before withdrawing cash.
examples.zh: 如果你忘记支付密码，可以在提现前通过应用重置。

entries.shortAnswer: 「账单」在英语里说 billing statement，常用于信用卡、话费或移动支付的消费明细；日常口语也直接说 bill。
entries.definition: billing statement 偏正式，指按月或按周期结算的消费明细，如信用卡账单、话费账单；单次消费的账单口语常用 bill，不要混用。

examples.en: I checked my billing statement and found an auto-renewal charge I forgot to cancel.
examples.zh: 我查看了账单，发现一笔忘记取消的自动续费扣款。

examples.en: The refund will go back to your original payment method, but it may take a few days to show up on your billing statement.
examples.zh: 退款会原路退回到你的原支付方式，但可能要几天才会显示在账单上。

entries.shortAnswer: billing statement 的中文意思是「账单」，指一段时间的消费或应付款明细；它强调周期结算，日常口语的 bill 更泛指一次消费的单据。
entries.definition: billing statement 为正式用语，常见搭配 receive a monthly billing statement、check your billing statement；移动支付里指账户消费与待还款明细，与单笔 receipt 不同。

examples.en: I checked my billing statement and found an auto-renewal charge I forgot to cancel.
examples.zh: 我查看了账单，发现一笔忘记取消的自动续费扣款。

examples.en: The refund will go back to your original payment method, but it may take a few days to show up on your billing statement.
examples.zh: 退款会原路退回到你的原支付方式，但可能要几天才会显示在账单上。

entries.shortAnswer: 「复试」的英文是 second-round interview，指通过初筛后的第二轮面试。注意与 final interview 区分，复试后可能还有终面。
entries.definition: second-round interview 常用于求职面试流程，尤其是秋招和社招中。通过初面后进入复试，可能涉及群面、谈薪或部门主管面。比 group interview 更强调轮次，不是指面试形式。

examples.en: After sending out resumes and passing the group interview, I was invited to a second-round interview with the department manager.
examples.zh: 投完简历并通过群面后，我收到了部门经理的复试邀请。

examples.en: During the second-round interview, we discussed salary negotiation and the non-compete agreement.
examples.zh: 在复试中，我们讨论了谈薪和竞业协议的事宜。

entries.shortAnswer: second-round interview 的中文意思是「复试」，指第一轮面试通过后的再次面试。与 final interview 不同，复试后可能还有终面或谈薪环节。
entries.definition: second-round interview 指求职中的第二轮面试，常见于秋招、社招流程。正式场合常用，口语也可说 second interview。注意不要与 group interview 混淆，后者指群面。

examples.en: After sending out resumes and passing the group interview, I was invited to a second-round interview with the department manager.
examples.zh: 投完简历并通过群面后，我收到了部门经理的复试邀请。

examples.en: During the second-round interview, we discussed salary negotiation and the non-compete agreement.
examples.zh: 在复试中，我们讨论了谈薪和竞业协议的事宜。

entries.shortAnswer: 「笔试」的英文是 written test，指求职或升学中书面作答的考核环节。它不同于面试 interview，通常用于筛选候选人，常与网申、简历筛选连用。
entries.definition: 求职场景中常说 take a written test（参加笔试）、pass the written test（通过笔试）。校招里笔试多在网申之后、面试之前进行；技术岗还常分 online written test（在线笔试）和现场笔试。

examples.en: After sending out resumes, I received an email inviting me to take an online written test next week.
examples.zh: 投完简历后，我收到一封邮件，邀请我下周参加在线笔试。

examples.en: The company uses the written test to screen candidates before the group interview and final salary negotiation.
examples.zh: 这家公司用笔试在群面和最终谈薪之前筛选候选人。

entries.shortAnswer: Written test 的中文意思是「笔试」，即用书面形式作答的考试或考核。它强调动笔答题，区别于口头面试 interview 和实操测试 practical test。
entries.definition: Written test 在招聘中常指淘汰性筛选环节，搭配有 take/pass/fail a written test、online written test。语气中性，正式与口语均可用；注意它不等于面试，别与 oral test 混用。

examples.en: After sending out resumes, I received an email inviting me to take an online written test next week.
examples.zh: 投完简历后，我收到一封邮件，邀请我下周参加在线笔试。

examples.en: The company uses the written test to screen candidates before the group interview and final salary negotiation.
examples.zh: 这家公司用笔试在群面和最终谈薪之前筛选候选人。

entries.shortAnswer: 「投简历」的英文是 send out resumes，指批量把简历发给多家公司。
entries.definition: send out resumes 指主动把简历发给多家公司，多用于海投。可说 send out resumes online 或 send out resumes to companies；单数为 send out a resume。

examples.en: During autumn recruitment, I sent out resumes to more than twenty companies in one week.
examples.zh: 秋招期间，我一周内向二十多家公司投了简历。

examples.en: She asked her senior schoolmate for a referral instead of just sending out resumes online.
examples.zh: 她没有只是在线投简历，而是找学长要了内推。

entries.shortAnswer: send out resumes 的中文意思是「投简历」，即把简历批量发给多家公司。
entries.definition: send out resumes 强调广投、批量发简历。可说 send out resumes online 或 send out resumes to recruiters；单数用 send out a resume。

examples.en: During autumn recruitment, I sent out resumes to more than twenty companies in one week.
examples.zh: 秋招期间，我一周内向二十多家公司投了简历。

examples.en: She asked her senior schoolmate for a referral instead of just sending out resumes online.
examples.zh: 她没有只是在线投简历，而是找学长要了内推。

entries.shortAnswer: 「实名认证」即 real-name verification，指平台核验用户真实身份信息。
entries.definition: 常见搭配有 complete real-name verification、require real-name verification。作定语时常加连字符，也可说 real-name authentication。

examples.en: You cannot withdraw cash from your mobile wallet until you complete real-name verification.
examples.zh: 在完成实名认证之前，你无法从移动钱包中提现。

examples.en: The app requires real-name verification before you can use scan to pay or set up auto-renewal.
examples.zh: 这款应用要求你先完成实名认证，之后才能使用扫码支付或开通自动续费。

entries.shortAnswer: real-name verification means「实名认证」: the platform checks a user's legal name and ID.
entries.definition: Used in mobile payments, bank accounts, and SIM registration. Common patterns: complete, pass, or require real-name verification.

examples.en: You cannot withdraw cash from your mobile wallet until you complete real-name verification.
examples.zh: 在完成实名认证之前，你无法从移动钱包中提现。

examples.en: The app requires real-name verification before you can use scan to pay or set up auto-renewal.
examples.zh: 这款应用要求你先完成实名认证，之后才能使用扫码支付或开通自动续费。

entries.shortAnswer: 「代付」的英文是 pay for someone，指替别人付款。移动支付中用自己的账户为对方扫码或下单付款，就是代付。
entries.definition: pay for someone 强调替他人承担费用，常用于朋友垫付、家人代买或请客。注意方向：若指对方自己付款，应用 pay by someone 或 pay for oneself。

examples.en: I can pay for someone with my phone if they forgot their wallet, but they'll have to transfer the money back to me later.
examples.zh: 如果对方忘带钱包，我可以用手机替他代付，不过之后他得把钱转回给我。

examples.en: In many shopping apps you can choose to pay for someone else, and the refund will go back to your original payment method.
examples.zh: 在很多购物应用里，你可以选择替别人代付，退款会原路退回到你的付款方式。

entries.shortAnswer: pay for someone 的中文意思是「代付」，即替别人付款。它强调由你出钱、对方受益，移动支付中常用自己的账户为对方扫码付款。
entries.definition: pay for someone 指替他人支付费用，口语中也说 cover someone 或 pay on someone's behalf。注意 for 后接被代付的人，若接付款方式则用 pay by。

examples.en: I can pay for someone with my phone if they forgot their wallet, but they'll have to transfer the money back to me later.
examples.zh: 如果对方忘带钱包，我可以用手机替他代付，不过之后他得把钱转回给我。

examples.en: In many shopping apps you can choose to pay for someone else, and the refund will go back to your original payment method.
examples.zh: 在很多购物应用里，你可以选择替别人代付，退款会原路退回到你的付款方式。

entries.shortAnswer: 在移动支付场景里，额度常译作 credit limit，指花呗、信用卡等可消费或透支的最高金额。
entries.definition: 额度指移动支付中花呗、信用卡等可用的最高消费或透支金额，常见搭配有提高额度、超出额度、额度不足。

examples.en: My credit limit on the mobile payment app is 5,000 yuan, so I can't scan to pay for this item.
examples.zh: 我在移动支付应用上的额度是五千元，所以无法扫码支付这件商品。

examples.en: If you exceed your credit limit, the payment may be declined, but any refund still goes back to your original method.
examples.zh: 如果你超出额度，付款可能被拒绝，但退款仍会原路退回。

entries.shortAnswer: In mobile payment, 额度 is credit limit: the maximum amount you can spend or borrow on a card or app.
entries.definition: In mobile payment, credit limit means the cap on spending or borrowing for cards, BNPL, and apps; you can raise, exceed, or run out of it.

examples.en: My credit limit on the mobile payment app is 5,000 yuan, so I can't scan to pay for this item.
examples.zh: 我在移动支付应用上的额度是五千元，所以无法扫码支付这件商品。

examples.en: If you exceed your credit limit, the payment may be declined, but any refund still goes back to your original method.
examples.zh: 如果你超出额度，付款可能被拒绝，但退款仍会原路退回。

entries.shortAnswer: 「薪资面议」的英文是 salary negotiable，常见于招聘启事。注意它表示薪水可谈，不是薪水保密，保密应说 salary confidential。
entries.definition: Salary negotiable 多用于招聘广告或面试邀约，暗示最终待遇取决于经验与谈判。若写 negotiable salary 虽可懂，但招聘惯用 salary negotiable。

examples.en: The job posting says salary negotiable, so I'll prepare for a salary negotiation during the interview.
examples.zh: 招聘启事上写着薪资面议，所以我会在面试时准备好谈薪。

examples.en: During the group interview, the HR manager mentioned that the salary is negotiable based on experience and benefits.
examples.zh: 群面时，HR经理提到薪资可根据经验和五险一金面议。

entries.shortAnswer: Salary negotiable 的中文意思是薪资面议，即薪水可以商量。它和 salary confidential（薪资保密）不同，前者可谈，后者不公开。
entries.definition: Salary negotiable 属于招聘正式用语，常见于职位描述或面试通知，表示具体薪酬待面谈确定。口语中也可说 pay is negotiable，但招聘文案更常用 salary negotiable。

examples.en: The job posting says salary negotiable, so I'll prepare for a salary negotiation during the interview.
examples.zh: 招聘启事上写着薪资面议，所以我会在面试时准备好谈薪。

examples.en: During the group interview, the HR manager mentioned that the salary is negotiable based on experience and benefits.
examples.zh: 群面时，HR经理提到薪资可根据经验和五险一金面议。

entries.shortAnswer: 「录用通知」的英文正式说法是 job offer，不是 offer letter（录用函）。口语也说 get an offer。
entries.definition: job offer 指用人单位正式发出的录用意向，可口头或书面。常见搭配：receive/accept/decline a job offer。注意与 offer letter（录用函）的区别。

examples.en: After three rounds of interviews, she finally got a job offer from the company.
examples.zh: 经过三轮面试，她终于收到了这家公司的录用通知。

examples.en: He decided to decline the job offer because the salary was too low.
examples.zh: 他决定拒绝这份录用通知，因为薪资太低。

entries.shortAnswer: 「job offer」的中文意思是「录用通知」，指用人单位正式提出录用。它与 employment contract（劳动合同）不同。
entries.definition: job offer 是招聘方发出的正式录用意向，可口头或书面。常见搭配：accept/turn down a job offer。offer letter 是书面文件，job offer 是工作机会本身。

examples.en: After three rounds of interviews, she finally got a job offer from the company.
examples.zh: 经过三轮面试，她终于收到了这家公司的录用通知。

examples.en: He decided to decline the job offer because the salary was too low.
examples.zh: 他决定拒绝这份录用通知，因为薪资太低。

entries.shortAnswer: 实习的英文是 internship，指学生或应届生为积累经验而做的短期工作，别与试用期混淆。
entries.definition: 用法：可数名词，如 do an internship、land an internship。常见搭配：summer internship（暑期实习）、internship program（实习项目）。

examples.en: I completed a summer internship at a tech company, which helped me land a full-time offer during autumn recruitment.
examples.zh: 我在一家科技公司完成了暑期实习，这帮助我在秋招期间拿到了全职工作录用通知。

examples.en: She sent out resumes for several internships, hoping to gain experience before graduation.
examples.zh: 她投递了几份实习简历，希望在毕业前积累经验。

entries.shortAnswer: Internship 的中文意思是实习，指学生为获取经验而做的短期工作，通常与学业相关。
entries.definition: 核心词义：一段临时工作经历，旨在培训或积累经验。常见搭配：paid internship、summer internship、internship program。

examples.en: I completed a summer internship at a tech company, which helped me land a full-time offer during autumn recruitment.
examples.zh: 我在一家科技公司完成了暑期实习，这帮助我在秋招期间拿到了全职工作录用通知。

examples.en: She sent out resumes for several internships, hoping to gain experience before graduation.
examples.zh: 她投递了几份实习简历，希望在毕业前积累经验。

entries.shortAnswer: 背景调查的英文是 background check，求职面试中常见于发 offer 前的核实环节，别和 background research 混淆。
entries.definition: background check 指雇主在录用前核实候选人的学历、工作经历、犯罪记录等，常搭配 run/conduct a background check、pass a background check，内推 referral 也不能免除背调。

examples.en: The company will run a background check before sending you the formal offer.
examples.zh: 公司在给你发正式录用通知前会做背景调查。

examples.en: Even with an internal referral, you still have to pass a background check.
examples.zh: 即使有内推，你仍然需要通过背景调查。

entries.shortAnswer: background check 的中文意思是背景调查，指录用前对候选人履历与记录的核实，与只联系证明人的 reference check 不同。
entries.definition: background check 指雇主核实学历、工作经历、信用与犯罪记录等，常见搭配 run/conduct/pass a background check，多用于正式书面与求职语境，别误译为“背景检查”。

examples.en: The company will run a background check before sending you the formal offer.
examples.zh: 公司在给你发正式录用通知前会做背景调查。

examples.en: Even with an internal referral, you still have to pass a background check.
examples.zh: 即使有内推，你仍然需要通过背景调查。

entries.shortAnswer: 五险一金的英文是 social insurance and housing fund，含五类社保和住房公积金，谈薪必问缴纳基数。
entries.definition: 五险一金指中国用人单位依法为员工缴纳的五类社会保险和住房公积金，常与社保基数、福利待遇一起讨论。

examples.en: Before accepting the offer, I asked how the company calculates social insurance and housing fund contributions.
examples.zh: 接受录用通知前，我问了公司如何计算五险一金的缴纳基数。

examples.en: The job posting mentions a competitive benefits package, which includes social insurance and housing fund.
examples.zh: 招聘信息提到有竞争力的福利待遇，其中包括五险一金。

entries.shortAnswer: Social insurance and housing fund is 五险一金: five statutory insurances plus the housing fund in China.
entries.definition: Social insurance and housing fund means 五险一金, China's five statutory insurances plus the housing fund, paid by employer and employee.

examples.en: Before accepting the offer, I asked how the company calculates social insurance and housing fund contributions.
examples.zh: 接受录用通知前，我问了公司如何计算五险一金的缴纳基数。

examples.en: The job posting mentions a competitive benefits package, which includes social insurance and housing fund.
examples.zh: 招聘信息提到有竞争力的福利待遇，其中包括五险一金。

entries.shortAnswer: 「猎头」的英文是 headhunter，指受企业委托、主动物色中高端人才的招聘顾问。
entries.definition: 猎头的英文是 headhunter，指受企业委托主动寻找中高端人才并收取佣金的顾问，也可作动词 headhunt（挖角）。

examples.en: A headhunter contacted me on LinkedIn about a senior product manager role.
examples.zh: 一位猎头在领英上联系我，说有一个高级产品经理的职位。

examples.en: She was headhunted by a rival firm and used the offer to negotiate a higher salary.
examples.zh: 她被一家竞争对手公司猎头挖角，并利用这个录用通知谈更高的薪资。

entries.shortAnswer: Headhunter means 猎头 in Chinese: a recruiter who finds and persuades candidates for companies.
entries.definition: A headhunter is a specialist recruiter who sources senior or hard-to-fill roles for companies and may handle salary talks.

examples.en: A headhunter contacted me on LinkedIn about a senior product manager role.
examples.zh: 一位猎头在领英上联系我，说有一个高级产品经理的职位。

examples.en: She was headhunted by a rival firm and used the offer to negotiate a higher salary.
examples.zh: 她被一家竞争对手公司猎头挖角，并利用这个录用通知谈更高的薪资。

entries.shortAnswer: 校招的英文是 campus recruitment，指企业面向应届生的校园招聘，通常分秋招和春招。
entries.definition: 校招即校园招聘，常见搭配有 campus recruitment season（校招季）、campus recruitment talk（宣讲会），注意与社招区分。

examples.en: I sent out my resume during campus recruitment and got a group interview invitation.
examples.zh: 我在校招期间投了简历，收到了群面邀请。

examples.en: Many companies offer referral bonuses during campus recruitment to encourage employees to recommend fresh graduates.
examples.zh: 许多公司在秋招期间提供内推奖金，鼓励员工推荐应届毕业生。

entries.shortAnswer: Campus recruitment means 校招, the campus hiring of fresh graduates, usually in autumn and spring.
entries.definition: Campus recruitment refers to companies hiring fresh graduates on campus, as in campus recruitment season or drive.

examples.en: I sent out my resume during campus recruitment and got a group interview invitation.
examples.zh: 我在校招期间投了简历，收到了群面邀请。

examples.en: Many companies offer referral bonuses during campus recruitment to encourage employees to recommend fresh graduates.
examples.zh: 许多公司在秋招期间提供内推奖金，鼓励员工推荐应届毕业生。

entries.shortAnswer: 社招指面向有工作经验者的招聘，英文常说 experienced hiring，区别于校招。
entries.definition: 指招聘有工作经验的人，英语常用 experienced hiring，而非 social recruitment。

examples.en: Many companies rely on experienced hiring to fill senior roles instead of training fresh graduates.
examples.zh: 许多公司依靠社招来填补高级职位，而不是培训应届毕业生。

examples.en: She sent out resumes through a referral and landed the job in the experienced hiring round.
examples.zh: 她通过内推投递简历，在社招环节拿到了这份工作。

entries.shortAnswer: experienced hiring 指社招，即面向有工作经验者的招聘，区别于校园招聘。
entries.definition: experienced hiring means 社招, hiring people with work experience, not fresh graduates.

examples.en: Many companies rely on experienced hiring to fill senior roles instead of training fresh graduates.
examples.zh: 许多公司依靠社招来填补高级职位，而不是培训应届毕业生。

examples.en: She sent out resumes through a referral and landed the job in the experienced hiring round.
examples.zh: 她通过内推投递简历，在社招环节拿到了这份工作。

entries.shortAnswer: 「双休」的英文是 two-day weekend，指每周休息两天，强调休息日天数，与五天工作制不同。
entries.definition: 求职时常见搭配：offer a two-day weekend、guarantee a two-day weekend。面试可问 Do you offer a two-day weekend? 中文「双休」侧重每周休两天。

examples.en: During the interview, I asked whether the company offers a two-day weekend.
examples.zh: 面试时我问了公司是否提供双休。

examples.en: Many candidates turn down offers without a two-day weekend, even if the salary is higher.
examples.zh: 许多求职者会拒绝没有双休的录用通知，即使薪资更高。

entries.shortAnswer: two-day weekend 的中文意思是「双休」，即每周休息两天，它强调休息天数，与五天工作制不同。
entries.definition: two-day weekend 指每周连续休息两天，常见于招聘广告和面试谈条件。口语也说 two days off a week；注意它不必然指周六日。

examples.en: During the interview, I asked whether the company offers a two-day weekend.
examples.zh: 面试时我问了公司是否提供双休。

examples.en: Many candidates turn down offers without a two-day weekend, even if the salary is higher.
examples.zh: 许多求职者会拒绝没有双休的录用通知，即使薪资更高。

entries.shortAnswer: 「离职证明」英文是 proof of resignation，指上一份工作结束的书面凭证，背调或入职新公司常需提交。
entries.definition: proof of resignation 是中性正式说法，由原单位开具，证明劳动关系已解除；不要与员工自己递交的 resignation letter（辞职信）混用。

examples.en: The HR department asked me to submit a proof of resignation before signing the new contract.
examples.zh: 人力资源部要求我在签新合同前提交离职证明。

examples.en: Without a proof of resignation, the background check may delay your onboarding.
examples.zh: 如果没有离职证明，背景调查可能会推迟你的入职。

entries.shortAnswer: Proof of resignation 即中文「离职证明」，指证明员工已与上一家公司解除劳动关系的正式文件，由公司开具。
entries.definition: Proof of resignation 为正式用语，常见搭配 provide/submit a proof of resignation，多用于入职背调或社保转移；注意与 resignation letter 区分。

examples.en: The HR department asked me to submit a proof of resignation before signing the new contract.
examples.zh: 人力资源部要求我在签新合同前提交离职证明。

examples.en: Without a proof of resignation, the background check may delay your onboarding.
examples.zh: 如果没有离职证明，背景调查可能会推迟你的入职。

entries.shortAnswer: 内推就是 internal referral，由在职员工推荐求职者，帮助简历直达招聘方。
entries.definition: internal referral 即内推，由目标公司在职员工推荐，成功后推荐人常有奖金。常见搭配：get an internal referral。

examples.en: I got an internal referral from a friend at the company, so my resume went straight to the hiring manager.
examples.zh: 我从公司里的一位朋友那里拿到了内推，所以我的简历直接到了招聘经理手上。

examples.en: Many Chinese tech companies treat internal referrals as a main hiring channel during autumn recruitment.
examples.zh: 许多中国科技公司在秋招期间把内推作为主要招聘渠道。

entries.shortAnswer: 内推 means internal referral: an employee recommends a candidate, often skipping screening.
entries.definition: An internal referral means a current employee recommends a candidate, often with a bonus. Common collocation: get an internal referral.

examples.en: I got an internal referral from a friend at the company, so my resume went straight to the hiring manager.
examples.zh: 我从公司里的一位朋友那里拿到了内推，所以我的简历直接到了招聘经理手上。

examples.en: Many Chinese tech companies treat internal referrals as a main hiring channel during autumn recruitment.
examples.zh: 许多中国科技公司在秋招期间把内推作为主要招聘渠道。

entries.shortAnswer: 远程面试的英文是 remote interview。注意不要直译为 long-distance interview，后者侧重物理距离，而 remote interview 强调通过视频或电话进行。
entries.definition: 远程面试常用搭配有 conduct a remote interview、schedule a remote interview。在求职场景中，它区别于线下面试（in-person interview），常见于秋招、外企招聘或异地求职。

examples.en: Due to the pandemic, many companies have shifted to remote interviews for the autumn recruitment season.
examples.zh: 受疫情影响，许多公司在秋招季转为远程面试。

examples.en: She prepared extensively for the remote interview, testing her camera and microphone beforehand.
examples.zh: 她为远程面试做了充分准备，提前测试了摄像头和麦克风。

entries.shortAnswer: remote interview 的中文意思是远程面试。它特指通过视频或电话进行的面试，与虚拟面试（virtual interview）近义，但更强调面试官与候选人不在同一地点。
entries.definition: remote interview 指通过视频会议软件或电话进行的面试，常见搭配有 do a remote interview、remote interview process。正式场合常用，比 phone screen 更正式，比 in-person interview 更灵活。

examples.en: Due to the pandemic, many companies have shifted to remote interviews for the autumn recruitment season.
examples.zh: 受疫情影响，许多公司在秋招季转为远程面试。

examples.en: She prepared extensively for the remote interview, testing her camera and microphone beforehand.
examples.zh: 她为远程面试做了充分准备，提前测试了摄像头和麦克风。

entries.shortAnswer: 竞业协议即 non-compete agreement，离职后限制加入竞争对手，与保密协议 NDA 不同。
entries.definition: non-compete agreement 常简写为 non-compete，指离职后一定期限内不得进入竞争公司或自营同类业务，公司通常需支付补偿。

examples.en: Before accepting the offer, she asked HR how long the non-compete agreement would last.
examples.zh: 在接受录用通知前，她问人力资源部这份竞业协议会持续多久。

examples.en: The company threatened to enforce the non-compete agreement when he joined a rival firm.
examples.zh: 他加入一家竞争对手公司时，公司威胁要执行竞业协议。

entries.shortAnswer: Non-compete agreement is 竞业协议: it limits joining a rival after leaving, unlike an NDA.
entries.definition: A non-compete agreement limits working for rivals for a set period, commonly with sign, breach and enforce as collocations.

examples.en: Before accepting the offer, she asked HR how long the non-compete agreement would last.
examples.zh: 在接受录用通知前，她问人力资源部这份竞业协议会持续多久。

examples.en: The company threatened to enforce the non-compete agreement when he joined a rival firm.
examples.zh: 他加入一家竞争对手公司时，公司威胁要执行竞业协议。

entries.shortAnswer: 「职业规划」的英文是 career plan，注意不要直译成 job plan 或 career planning，后者指规划的过程。
entries.definition: career plan 指个人对职业发展路径的长期安排，常见搭配有 a clear career plan、make a career plan、discuss your career plan，面试时被问 career plan 要结合岗位和公司发展来答。

examples.en: During the interview, the HR manager asked me to describe my career plan for the next five years.
examples.zh: 面试时，人力资源经理让我描述一下自己未来五年的职业规划。

examples.en: Autumn recruitment is the best time for graduates to turn their career plan into reality by sending out resumes and preparing for group interviews.
examples.zh: 秋招是毕业生把职业规划变成现实的最佳时机，他们可以投简历并准备群面。

entries.shortAnswer: career plan 的中文意思是「职业规划」，指对职业发展路径的长期安排，与侧重过程的 career planning 不同。
entries.definition: career plan 是可数名词，常见搭配有 have a career plan、discuss your career plan、a five-year career plan，求职面试中常用来询问候选人的长期目标，口语里也常说 career goals。

examples.en: During the interview, the HR manager asked me to describe my career plan for the next five years.
examples.zh: 面试时，人力资源经理让我描述一下自己未来五年的职业规划。

examples.en: Autumn recruitment is the best time for graduates to turn their career plan into reality by sending out resumes and preparing for group interviews.
examples.zh: 秋招是毕业生把职业规划变成现实的最佳时机，他们可以投简历并准备群面。

entries.shortAnswer: 弹性工作的英文是 flexible work hours，指可自主调整上下班时间，常被列为求职福利。
entries.definition: 求职简历和面试中常用 flexible work hours 表示灵活上下班，而非完全自由安排。可搭配 offer flexible work hours、request flexible work hours，注意与 remote work 区分。

examples.en: During the interview, the HR manager mentioned that the company offers flexible work hours, which is a big plus for me.
examples.zh: 面试时，人力资源经理提到公司提供弹性工作，这对我来说是一个很大的加分项。

examples.en: Many job postings list flexible work hours as a benefit to attract candidates who need to balance family and career.
examples.zh: 许多招聘信息把弹性工作列为福利，以吸引需要平衡家庭和事业的求职者。

entries.shortAnswer: Flexible work hours is 弹性工作 in Chinese, meaning adjustable start and end times, often a job benefit.
entries.definition: Flexible work hours 指弹性工作制，常见搭配 offer/allow flexible work hours。多用于正式招聘和面试，口语也可说 flexi hours。易错点：不等于 unlimited time off 或完全远程。

examples.en: During the interview, the HR manager mentioned that the company offers flexible work hours, which is a big plus for me.
examples.zh: 面试时，人力资源经理提到公司提供弹性工作，这对我来说是一个很大的加分项。

examples.en: Many job postings list flexible work hours as a benefit to attract candidates who need to balance family and career.
examples.zh: 许多招聘信息把弹性工作列为福利，以吸引需要平衡家庭和事业的求职者。

entries.shortAnswer: 「期望薪资」英文是 expected salary，求职面试常用，注意别说 hope salary。
entries.definition: expected salary 指求职时期望的薪资，常见问法：What is your expected salary?

examples.en: The interviewer asked about my expected salary, so I gave a range.
examples.zh: 面试官问了我的期望薪资，所以我给了一个范围。

examples.en: You can say your expected salary is negotiable in the cover letter.
examples.zh: 你可以在求职信中说期望薪资面议。

entries.shortAnswer: 「期望薪资」 in English is expected salary, the pay you hope to get in a job.
entries.definition: Expected salary means the pay you want for a job, asked in interviews.

examples.en: The interviewer asked about my expected salary, so I gave a range.
examples.zh: 面试官问了我的期望薪资，所以我给了一个范围。

examples.en: You can say your expected salary is negotiable in the cover letter.
examples.zh: 你可以在求职信中说期望薪资面议。

entries.shortAnswer: 「自我介绍」的英文是 self introduction，求职面试中常说 give a self introduction。
entries.definition: self introduction 指介绍自己姓名、背景与经历的陈述，面试中常用 give a brief self introduction。

examples.en: During the interview, she gave a clear self introduction covering her education and internship experience.
examples.zh: 面试中，她做了一个清晰的自我介绍，涵盖教育背景和实习经历。

examples.en: A strong self introduction can help you stand out in autumn recruitment.
examples.zh: 一段出色的自我介绍能帮你在秋招中脱颖而出。

entries.shortAnswer: Self introduction 的中文意思是「自我介绍」，指面试中介绍自身背景的陈述。
entries.definition: self introduction 指一段介绍自己姓名、教育、经历与技能的陈述，常见搭配 give a self introduction。

examples.en: During the interview, she gave a clear self introduction covering her education and internship experience.
examples.zh: 面试中，她做了一个清晰的自我介绍，涵盖教育背景和实习经历。

examples.en: A strong self introduction can help you stand out in autumn recruitment.
examples.zh: 一段出色的自我介绍能帮你在秋招中脱颖而出。

entries.shortAnswer: 「离职原因」的英文是 reason for leaving，求职面试常用，解释上一份工作为何结束，比 quit reason 正式。
entries.definition: 面试官问 What is your reason for leaving? 是了解你离开上家公司的动机。常见搭配：state a reason for leaving。

examples.en: When the interviewer asked about my reason for leaving, I said I wanted to move into a role with more responsibility.
examples.zh: 面试官问我离职原因时，我说我想转向一个职责更多的岗位。

examples.en: A vague reason for leaving can raise doubts, so keep it honest but positive.
examples.zh: 含糊的离职原因会引起怀疑，所以回答要诚实但积极。

entries.shortAnswer: reason for leaving 的中文意思是「离职原因」，是求职面试常见问法，比 quit reason 正式，指你为何离开上一份工作。
entries.definition: reason for leaving 多用于面试和招聘表格，询问候选人离开前雇主的动机。常见搭配：ask about your reason for leaving。

examples.en: When the interviewer asked about my reason for leaving, I said I wanted to move into a role with more responsibility.
examples.zh: 面试官问我离职原因时，我说我想转向一个职责更多的岗位。

examples.en: A vague reason for leaving can raise doubts, so keep it honest but positive.
examples.zh: 含糊的离职原因会引起怀疑，所以回答要诚实但积极。

entries.shortAnswer: 「谈薪」的英文是 salary negotiation，指求职者与雇主就薪资待遇进行的协商，动词形式常说 negotiate a salary。
entries.definition: salary negotiation 常用于招聘后期或收到 offer 后，双方就基本工资、奖金、股票、福利等展开协商。正式场合用 negotiate the salary 或 salary negotiation 更地道。

examples.en: After receiving the offer, she spent a week preparing for the salary negotiation.
examples.zh: 收到录用通知后，她花了一周时间为谈薪做准备。

examples.en: Good research can give you more leverage during salary negotiation.
examples.zh: 充分的调研能让你在谈薪时拥有更多筹码。

entries.shortAnswer: salary negotiation 的中文意思是「谈薪」，即求职者与雇主就薪酬待遇进行的正式协商，强调对等谈判。
entries.definition: salary negotiation 指 offer 阶段就 base salary、bonus、equity、benefits 等进行的正式协商，常见搭配有 enter into salary negotiations。

examples.en: After receiving the offer, she spent a week preparing for the salary negotiation.
examples.zh: 收到录用通知后，她花了一周时间为谈薪做准备。

examples.en: Good research can give you more leverage during salary negotiation.
examples.zh: 充分的调研能让你在谈薪时拥有更多筹码。

entries.shortAnswer: 「租房」的英文是 rent an apartment，指租下一整套公寓自住。若只是租一个房间或与人合租，更常说 rent a room 或 flatshare。
entries.definition: rent an apartment 强调租下整套公寓，租房前通常要交 security deposit（押金），签约时留意押一付三和 utilities（水电费）是否包含。合租用 flatshare，转租用 sublet，退租是 move out。

examples.en: We decided to rent an apartment near the subway to cut down on commuting time.
examples.zh: 我们决定在地铁附近租房，以减少通勤时间。

examples.en: Before you rent an apartment, check whether the utilities and property management fee are included in the rent.
examples.zh: 租房前要问清楚房租里是否包含水电费和物业费。

entries.shortAnswer: Rent an apartment 的中文意思是「租房」，通常指租下一整套公寓。它与 rent a room 的区别在于前者租整套房，后者只租一个房间。
entries.definition: rent an apartment 是中性表达，正式租房广告和日常口语都常用。常见搭配：rent an apartment near the subway、rent a furnished apartment。注意英式英语中公寓更多说 flat，合租常说 flatshare。

examples.en: We decided to rent an apartment near the subway to cut down on commuting time.
examples.zh: 我们决定在地铁附近租房，以减少通勤时间。

examples.en: Before you rent an apartment, check whether the utilities and property management fee are included in the rent.
examples.zh: 租房前要问清楚房租里是否包含水电费和物业费。

entries.shortAnswer: 房东的英文是 landlord，指拥有房屋并出租的人。注意 landlord 通常指男性房东，女房东可用 landlady，性别不明时用 landlord 更通用。
entries.definition: 租房场景中，向房东支付租金、押金和可能的水电费；房东负责维修和物业费。二房东是 sublandlord。英式英语中也常用 landlord 指酒吧老板。

examples.en: I paid the landlord the first month's rent and a security deposit before moving in.
examples.zh: 搬进去之前，我向房东支付了第一个月的租金和押金。

examples.en: The landlord promised to fix the leaking pipe, but he hasn't shown up yet.
examples.zh: 房东答应修理漏水的水管，但他还没露面。

entries.shortAnswer: Landlord 的中文意思是房东，即出租房屋并收取租金的人。它与 tenant（房客）相对，女房东可称 landlady，但 landlord 更通用。
entries.definition: Landlord 是租赁关系中的出租方，常与 tenant、rent、lease、security deposit 搭配。口语中也可指酒吧老板。注意不要与 homeowner（自住房主）混淆。

examples.en: I paid the landlord the first month's rent and a security deposit before moving in.
examples.zh: 搬进去之前，我向房东支付了第一个月的租金和押金。

examples.en: The landlord promised to fix the leaking pipe, but he hasn't shown up yet.
examples.zh: 房东答应修理漏水的水管，但他还没露面。

entries.shortAnswer: 秋招的英文是 autumn recruitment，指中国每年秋季的校园招聘。注意美式英语常说 fall recruitment，英国和澳大利亚更常用 autumn recruitment。
entries.definition: 秋招即秋季校园招聘，常涉及投简历、笔试、群面、内推。搭配：autumn recruitment season（秋招季）。

examples.en: I need to send out my resumes before the autumn recruitment season starts.
examples.zh: 我需要在秋招季开始前投递简历。

examples.en: She got a referral for the autumn recruitment and skipped the group interview.
examples.zh: 她通过秋招内推获得了面试机会，跳过了群面。

entries.shortAnswer: Autumn recruitment 的中文意思是秋招，即中国每年秋季的校园招聘。它与 spring recruitment（春招）相对，是应届生求职的重要窗口。
entries.definition: Autumn recruitment 指秋季校园招聘，公司集中招聘应届毕业生。搭配：participate in autumn recruitment（参加秋招）。

examples.en: I need to send out my resumes before the autumn recruitment season starts.
examples.zh: 我需要在秋招季开始前投递简历。

examples.en: She got a referral for the autumn recruitment and skipped the group interview.
examples.zh: 她通过秋招内推获得了面试机会，跳过了群面。

entries.shortAnswer: 「群面」的英文是 group interview，指多名求职者被安排在同一场面试中同时接受考察。
entries.definition: group interview 即「群面」，多名候选人同场面试，常见于校招。易混词 panel interview 指多对一面试。

examples.en: I passed the group interview last week and moved on to the final one-on-one round.
examples.zh: 我上周通过了群面，进入了最后一轮一对一面试。

examples.en: During the group interview, we were asked to discuss a business case and present our solution.
examples.zh: 群面时，我们被要求讨论一个商业案例并展示解决方案。

entries.shortAnswer: Group interview 的中文意思是「群面」，即多名候选人被安排在同一场面试中同时接受考察。
entries.definition: group interview 指多位求职者同场面试，常见于校招。常见搭配：attend a group interview。

examples.en: I passed the group interview last week and moved on to the final one-on-one round.
examples.zh: 我上周通过了群面，进入了最后一轮一对一面试。

examples.en: During the group interview, we were asked to discuss a business case and present our solution.
examples.zh: 群面时，我们被要求讨论一个商业案例并展示解决方案。

entries.shortAnswer: 「押金」的英文是 security deposit，常见于美国租房合同；英国更常说 deposit，口语里也直接说 deposit。
entries.definition: security deposit 指租房时交给房东的押金，退租时若无损坏或欠费应全额退还。注意它和 rent（租金）不同，也不能写成 deposit security 这种倒装。

examples.en: The landlord asked for one month's rent as a security deposit.
examples.zh: 房东要求交一个月租金作为押金。

examples.en: If nothing is damaged, you should get your security deposit back after you move out.
examples.zh: 如果没有东西损坏，退租后你应该能拿回押金。

entries.shortAnswer: security deposit 的中文意思是「押金」，是租房时预先支付给房东的一笔保证金。它和 rent（租金）不同，通常会在退租 move out 时退还。
entries.definition: security deposit 指租房押金，房东用来抵扣可能的损坏、欠租或清洁费用。常见搭配有 pay a security deposit、get the security deposit back；英国租房更多用 deposit。

examples.en: The landlord asked for one month's rent as a security deposit.
examples.zh: 房东要求交一个月租金作为押金。

examples.en: If nothing is damaged, you should get your security deposit back after you move out.
examples.zh: 如果没有东西损坏，退租后你应该能拿回押金。

entries.shortAnswer: 中介费的英文是 agency fee，指租房或买房时付给中介机构的服务费，通常不可退。
entries.definition: agency fee 指通过中介租房或买房时支付的服务佣金，通常为一个月租金，签约时支付。

examples.en: The agency fee is usually one month's rent, and it is paid when you sign the lease.
examples.zh: 中介费通常是一个月租金，在签租约时支付。

examples.en: Before you pay the agency fee, ask whether it is refundable if you decide not to move in.
examples.zh: 在支付中介费之前，先问清楚如果你决定不入住，这笔费用是否可退。

entries.shortAnswer: agency fee 的中文意思是中介费，即租客或买家付给中介机构的服务佣金，一般不退。
entries.definition: agency fee 指租房或买房时付给中介机构的服务费，常见搭配 pay an agency fee、charge an agency fee。

examples.en: The agency fee is usually one month's rent, and it is paid when you sign the lease.
examples.zh: 中介费通常是一个月租金，在签租约时支付。

examples.en: Before you pay the agency fee, ask whether it is refundable if you decide not to move in.
examples.zh: 在支付中介费之前，先问清楚如果你决定不入住，这笔费用是否可退。

entries.shortAnswer: 合租的英文是 flat sharing，英式常用 flatshare。注意美式英语更常说 roommate 或 shared apartment。
entries.definition: flat sharing 指多人分摊房租合住一套公寓，常涉及分摊水电费（utilities）和押金（security deposit）。英式口语常用 flatshare 或 house share；美式则说 roommates 或 shared housing。

examples.en: Flat sharing is a popular way to save money on rent in big cities like London.
examples.zh: 在大城市如伦敦，合租是节省租金的一种流行方式。

examples.en: Before you start flat sharing, make sure you understand the rules about the security deposit and utilities.
examples.zh: 在开始合租之前，确保你了解关于押金和水电费的规则。

entries.shortAnswer: flat sharing 的中文意思是合租，指多人合住一套公寓并分摊费用。它强调共享居住空间，与整租（whole apartment rental）相对。
entries.definition: flat sharing 是英式英语，指合租公寓，常搭配 go flat sharing、flat sharing agreement。美式英语多用 roommate 或 shared apartment。注意与 sublet（转租）不同，后者是转租他人租约。

examples.en: Flat sharing is a popular way to save money on rent in big cities like London.
examples.zh: 在大城市如伦敦，合租是节省租金的一种流行方式。

examples.en: Before you start flat sharing, make sure you understand the rules about the security deposit and utilities.
examples.zh: 在开始合租之前，确保你了解关于押金和水电费的规则。

entries.shortAnswer: 「租客」的英文是 tenant，指付租金租房居住的人，比 renter 更正式，常见于合同。
entries.definition: tenant 是正式用词，常见于租房合同和法规，如 tenant rights；与房主 landlord 相对，强调合法居住权。

examples.en: The tenant must pay the rent before the first day of each month.
examples.zh: 租客必须在每月第一天之前交房租。

examples.en: The landlord asked the tenant to keep the noise down at night.
examples.zh: 房东要求租客晚上别太吵。

entries.shortAnswer: Tenant means 租客 in Chinese, a person who pays rent to live in a place, more formal than renter.
entries.definition: Tenant refers to someone who rents a home. It is formal, used in leases and tenant rights, unlike renter or lodger.

examples.en: The tenant must pay the rent before the first day of each month.
examples.zh: 租客必须在每月第一天之前交房租。

examples.en: The landlord asked the tenant to keep the noise down at night.
examples.zh: 房东要求租客晚上别太吵。

entries.shortAnswer: 「整租」的英文是 whole apartment rental，指租下整套公寓独自使用，不与房东或他人合住。
entries.definition: 整租指独立租用整套房，含厨房、卫生间等设施；常见搭配有 look for a whole apartment rental。与合租相对，需自付全部租金。

examples.en: After saving for a year, she finally signed a whole apartment rental lease in the city center.
examples.zh: 攒了一年钱后，她终于在市中心签了一套整租的租约。

examples.en: A whole apartment rental usually costs more than flat sharing, but you get more privacy and space.
examples.zh: 整租通常比合租贵，但你能获得更多隐私和空间。

entries.shortAnswer: Whole apartment rental 的中文意思是「整租」，即租下整套公寓独自使用，强调空间独立，区别于合租。
entries.definition: Whole apartment rental 指租整套公寓，通常含卧室、厨房、卫生间等独立设施，常见于租房广告。口语可说 rent the whole apartment。

examples.en: After saving for a year, she finally signed a whole apartment rental lease in the city center.
examples.zh: 攒了一年钱后，她终于在市中心签了一套整租的租约。

examples.en: A whole apartment rental usually costs more than flat sharing, but you get more privacy and space.
examples.zh: 整租通常比合租贵，但你能获得更多隐私和空间。

entries.shortAnswer: 「房租」的英文是 monthly rent，指租房时按月支付给房东的住房租金，常与水电费分开计算。
entries.definition: 常用搭配有 pay the monthly rent（交房租）、monthly rent is due（房租到期）；通常还需另付水电费和物业费。

examples.en: Our monthly rent is 4,000 yuan, plus utilities and a property management fee.
examples.zh: 我们的房租是每月四千元，另外还要付水电费和物业费。

examples.en: Before you move out, make sure the monthly rent for the last month is paid.
examples.zh: 退租前，请确认最后一个月的房租已经付清。

entries.shortAnswer: "Monthly rent" 的中文意思是「房租」，即租客每月支付给房东的住房租金，通常不含水电费。
entries.definition: monthly rent 指每月应付的住房租金，常见搭配 pay the monthly rent、rent plus utilities，常与水电费分开计算。

examples.en: Our monthly rent is 4,000 yuan, plus utilities and a property management fee.
examples.zh: 我们的房租是每月四千元，另外还要付水电费和物业费。

examples.en: Before you move out, make sure the monthly rent for the last month is paid.
examples.zh: 退租前，请确认最后一个月的房租已经付清。

entries.shortAnswer: 拎包入住英文是 move-in ready，指带全套家具家电、提包就能住的出租房。注意英文 move-in ready 偏指装修完毕，家电全配要另加 fully furnished。
entries.definition: 中国租房平台高频卖点词，强调家具、家电、网络全配，租客只需带个人物品。英文 move-in ready 原指房屋装修完好可直接入住，不一定含家具，若想表达全配，可说 fully furnished and move-in ready，租房时务必和房东确认清楚。

examples.en: The apartment is move-in ready, so we just need to bring our suitcases and pay the security deposit.
examples.zh: 这套公寓拎包入住，我们只需带上行李箱并支付押金。

examples.en: Many Chinese rental listings advertise move-in ready, but you should check whether it is fully furnished before signing the lease.
examples.zh: 中国很多租房广告都写拎包入住，但签租约前你应该确认是否全配家具家电。

entries.shortAnswer: move-in ready 中文意思是拎包入住，指房子装修完好、可立即入住。它偏重房屋状态，不一定包含家具家电，全配需说 fully furnished。
entries.definition: 英文常用租房广告词，强调无需装修或大修，可马上搬入。与 fully furnished 不同，后者专指配备家具家电。口语和书面均用，看房时若要求家电全配，应明确问 Is it fully furnished? 避免误会。

examples.en: The apartment is move-in ready, so we just need to bring our suitcases and pay the security deposit.
examples.zh: 这套公寓拎包入住，我们只需带上行李箱并支付押金。

examples.en: Many Chinese rental listings advertise move-in ready, but you should check whether it is fully furnished before signing the lease.
examples.zh: 中国很多租房广告都写拎包入住，但签租约前你应该确认是否全配家具家电。

entries.shortAnswer: 「室友」的英文是 roommate，指合租或同住一室的人；美式常用 roommate，英式常用 flatmate。
entries.definition: roommate 多用于美式英语，指共享公寓或房间的人；英式更常用 flatmate。常见搭配：my roommate、college roommate。

examples.en: My roommate and I split the rent and utilities evenly every month.
examples.zh: 我和室友每月平摊房租和水电费。

examples.en: She found a new roommate to take over her lease before moving out.
examples.zh: 她在搬走前找到了一个新室友来接手她的租约。

entries.shortAnswer: Roommate 的中文意思是「室友」，指合租公寓或同住一室的人；美式英语更常用 roommate，英式常用 flatmate。
entries.definition: Roommate 指与你共享住所的人，可合租公寓或同住一室。常见搭配：college roommate、find a roommate、roommate agreement。

examples.en: My roommate and I split the rent and utilities evenly every month.
examples.zh: 我和室友每月平摊房租和水电费。

examples.en: She found a new roommate to take over her lease before moving out.
examples.zh: 她在搬走前找到了一个新室友来接手她的租约。

entries.shortAnswer: 「水电费」的英文是 utilities，指水、电、燃气等公共事业费用，租房时常用。
entries.definition: utilities 指水、电、燃气等公共事业费用，租房时常指需另付的杂费，如 pay utilities、utilities included。

examples.en: The rent is $1,200 a month, but utilities are not included, so we split the water and electricity bills.
examples.zh: 月租是1200美元，但不包水电费，所以我们分摊水费和电费。

examples.en: When you move out, make sure to cancel or transfer the utilities to avoid extra charges.
examples.zh: 搬走时，一定要取消或过户水电费账户，以免产生额外费用。

entries.shortAnswer: Utilities 的中文意思是水电费，指租房时需另付的水、电、燃气等公共事业费用。
entries.definition: utilities 作复数名词，指水、电、燃气等公共事业费用，常见于租房语境，如 utilities included。

examples.en: The rent is $1,200 a month, but utilities are not included, so we split the water and electricity bills.
examples.zh: 月租是1200美元，但不包水电费，所以我们分摊水费和电费。

examples.en: When you move out, make sure to cancel or transfer the utilities to avoid extra charges.
examples.zh: 搬走时，一定要取消或过户水电费账户，以免产生额外费用。

entries.shortAnswer: “物业费”英文是 property management fee，指业主或住户缴纳的物业管理服务费，租房时需确认由谁支付。
entries.definition: “物业费”常搭配 pay the property management fee，英美租房多由房东承担，中国租房可能由租客付，签约前务必确认。

examples.en: The rent is 3,000 yuan a month, and the property management fee is paid by the landlord.
examples.zh: 月租三千元，物业费由房东支付。

examples.en: Before you sign the lease, ask whether the property management fee is included in the rent or paid separately.
examples.zh: 签租约前，问清楚物业费是包含在租金里还是单独支付。

entries.shortAnswer: “property management fee”即“物业费”，指公寓或小区收取的管理服务费，通常与租金分开，租房前应问清由谁支付。
entries.definition: property management fee 指物业管理费，常搭配 pay a monthly property management fee，英美多由房东付，中国可能租客付。

examples.en: The rent is 3,000 yuan a month, and the property management fee is paid by the landlord.
examples.zh: 月租三千元，物业费由房东支付。

examples.en: Before you sign the lease, ask whether the property management fee is included in the rent or paid separately.
examples.zh: 签租约前，问清楚物业费是包含在租金里还是单独支付。

entries.shortAnswer: 「押一付三」英文是 one-month deposit three-month rent，指押一个月房租、一次付三个月房租，常见于中国整租。
entries.definition: 押一付三指押金为一个月租金，房租一次预付三个月，常见于整租，合租或转租也可能采用这种付款方式。

examples.en: The landlord requires a one-month deposit three-month rent, so I must pay four months' rent before moving in.
examples.zh: 房东要求押一付三，所以我搬进去前要一次付四个月房租。

examples.en: Compared with monthly rent in the UK, a one-month deposit three-month rent is a heavy cash burden for young renters.
examples.zh: 与英国按月付租相比，押一付三对年轻租客是沉重的现金负担。

entries.shortAnswer: one-month deposit three-month rent is「押一付三」: one month's rent as deposit plus three months upfront.
entries.definition: one-month deposit three-month rent describes paying one month's rent as a deposit and three months' rent upfront, common in Chinese整租.

examples.en: The landlord requires a one-month deposit three-month rent, so I must pay four months' rent before moving in.
examples.zh: 房东要求押一付三，所以我搬进去前要一次付四个月房租。

examples.en: Compared with monthly rent in the UK, a one-month deposit three-month rent is a heavy cash burden for young renters.
examples.zh: 与英国按月付租相比，押一付三对年轻租客是沉重的现金负担。

entries.shortAnswer: 退租的英文是 move out and end lease，指租约未到期或到期后正式搬走并终止租赁合同；日常口语中也常说 move out，但强调解约时需补上 end lease。
entries.definition: 退租常用于整租或合租场景，核心是提前通知房东、结清水电费 utilities、拿回押金 security deposit。注意与转租 sublet 不同：退租是彻底终止合同，转租是把租约转给他人。

examples.en: I need to move out and end lease before the end of next month because I'm relocating for work.
examples.zh: 我下个月底前需要退租，因为我要因工作搬迁。

examples.en: If you move out and end lease early, the landlord may deduct the remaining rent from your security deposit.
examples.zh: 如果你提前退租，房东可能会从你的押金里扣除剩余租金。

entries.shortAnswer: move out and end lease 的中文意思是退租，即搬离租住房屋并正式终止租赁合同；它比单纯 move out 多出解约的法律含义，强调合同关系结束。
entries.definition: move out and end lease 多用于正式或书面语境，指租客按约定搬走并解除租约；口语中常简化成 move out，但涉及押金 security deposit 或违约责任时，需明确 end lease。

examples.en: I need to move out and end lease before the end of next month because I'm relocating for work.
examples.zh: 我下个月底前需要退租，因为我要因工作搬迁。

examples.en: If you move out and end lease early, the landlord may deduct the remaining rent from your security deposit.
examples.zh: 如果你提前退租，房东可能会从你的押金里扣除剩余租金。

entries.shortAnswer: 装修的英文是 renovation，指对房屋进行翻新或改造。注意 renovation 侧重翻新和翻修，不是简单的装饰或家具布置。
entries.definition: Renovation 常指房屋翻新、整修，如 home renovation、kitchen renovation。装修还可说 remodeling（美式）或 refurbishment。装饰（贴墙纸、摆家具）用 decoration，别混用。

examples.en: The landlord agreed to a renovation of the kitchen before we moved in.
examples.zh: 房东同意在我们搬进去之前翻新厨房。

examples.en: We spent the whole summer doing a renovation of the rented flat.
examples.zh: 我们花了整个夏天翻新那套租来的公寓。

entries.shortAnswer: Renovation 的中文意思是装修，多指对房屋进行翻新或改造。它侧重翻新和翻修，与 decoration 装饰不同，后者指刷墙、贴墙纸等表面美化。
entries.definition: Renovation 指房屋翻新、整修，常见搭配 kitchen renovation、home renovation。美式英语也常用 remodeling。装饰、表面美化用 decoration，别混淆。

examples.en: The landlord agreed to a renovation of the kitchen before we moved in.
examples.zh: 房东同意在我们搬进去之前翻新厨房。

examples.en: We spent the whole summer doing a renovation of the rented flat.
examples.zh: 我们花了整个夏天翻新那套租来的公寓。

entries.shortAnswer: 「邻居」的英文是 neighbor，指住在你旁边或附近的人。注意：英式拼写为 neighbour，且 neighbor 不用于指“室友”（roommate）。
entries.definition: 在租房生活中，neighbor 常用来描述隔壁或同楼的住户，比如“my next-door neighbor”（隔壁邻居）或“a noisy neighbor”（吵闹的邻居）。与 roommate（合租室友）不同，neighbor 不一定同住一套房。

examples.en: My neighbor helped me carry my luggage when I moved into the new apartment.
examples.zh: 我搬进新公寓时，邻居帮我搬了行李。

examples.en: We invited our neighbors over for dinner to get to know them better.
examples.zh: 我们邀请邻居过来吃晚饭，以便更好地了解他们。

entries.shortAnswer: “Neighbor”的中文意思是“邻居”，指住在附近或隔壁的人。它和“roommate”（室友）不同，邻居通常不与你共享同一套房子。
entries.definition: Neighbor 是通用词，可指隔壁、同楼或同社区的住户。常见搭配有 next-door neighbor（隔壁邻居）、neighborly（友好的）。在合租场景中，注意与 flatmate/roommate 区分。

examples.en: My neighbor helped me carry my luggage when I moved into the new apartment.
examples.zh: 我搬进新公寓时，邻居帮我搬了行李。

examples.en: We invited our neighbors over for dinner to get to know them better.
examples.zh: 我们邀请邻居过来吃晚饭，以便更好地了解他们。

entries.shortAnswer: 「居委会」的英文是 neighborhood committee。在租房场景中，它常负责居住证明、纠纷调解和社区事务，不是物业物业公司。
entries.definition: neighborhood committee 指中国城市的基层群众自治组织，负责社区管理，如开居住证明、调解邻里纠纷、组织社区活动。与物业公司不同，它不负责维修和安保。

examples.en: When I moved into my new apartment, the landlord asked me to register with the neighborhood committee.
examples.zh: 我搬进新公寓时，房东让我去居委会登记。

examples.en: If you have a dispute with your roommate, you can ask the neighborhood committee to help mediate.
examples.zh: 如果你和室友有纠纷，可以请居委会帮忙调解。

entries.shortAnswer: Neighborhood committee 的中文意思是「居委会」。它是中国城市基层的居民自治组织，负责社区事务，区别于商业物业公司。
entries.definition: 指中国城市社区的居民委员会，官方译法为 neighborhood committee 或 residents' committee。常见搭配：neighborhood committee office（居委会办公室）。口语中也可说 residents' committee。

examples.en: When I moved into my new apartment, the landlord asked me to register with the neighborhood committee.
examples.zh: 我搬进新公寓时，房东让我去居委会登记。

examples.en: If you have a dispute with your roommate, you can ask the neighborhood committee to help mediate.
examples.zh: 如果你和室友有纠纷，可以请居委会帮忙调解。

entries.shortAnswer: 转租的英文是 sublet，指租客将租赁的房屋部分或全部再租给第三人。关键区别：sublet 通常指留下部分自住或保留原租约，而转租整个房子则常用 sublease 或 assign。
entries.definition: sublet 主要作动词，也可作名词。常见搭配：sublet a room/apartment to sb。与 sublease 常可互换，但 sublet 更口语化。注意：转租前通常需房东同意，否则可能违约。

examples.en: I need to sublet my apartment for the summer while I'm away.
examples.zh: 我夏天不在的时候需要把公寓转租出去。

examples.en: She sublet a room to a student to help cover the rent.
examples.zh: 她把一个房间转租给一个学生来帮忙分担租金。

entries.shortAnswer: Sublet 的中文意思是转租，即租客将租来的房子再租给别人。关键区别：sublet 时原租客仍对房东负责，而转让租约（assign）则完全退出。
entries.definition: Sublet 可作动词或名词，常见搭配：sublet a room to someone。比 sublease 更口语。注意：许多租约要求房东书面同意才能转租，否则可能被收回房子。

examples.en: I need to sublet my apartment for the summer while I'm away.
examples.zh: 我夏天不在的时候需要把公寓转租出去。

examples.en: She sublet a room to a student to help cover the rent.
examples.zh: 她把一个房间转租给一个学生来帮忙分担租金。

entries.shortAnswer: 到期续租的英文是 lease renewal，指租约期满时重新签约或延长租期，注意与转租 sublet 区分。
entries.definition: lease renewal 用于正式租房场景，常搭配 sign a lease renewal、offer a lease renewal；口语也可说 renew the lease。易错点：到期续租是原租客与房东续约，转租 sublet 是把房转给第三方。

examples.en: The landlord sent me a lease renewal offer two months before my current lease expires.
examples.zh: 房东在当前租约到期前两个月给我发来了续租要约。

examples.en: If you want to stay in the same flat, you need to discuss a lease renewal with the property management company.
examples.zh: 如果你想继续住同一套公寓，需要和物业公司谈到期续租。

entries.shortAnswer: lease renewal 的中文是到期续租，指租约期满时续签或延长租期，区别于转租 sublet。
entries.definition: lease renewal 指到期续租，即租约期满时重新签约或延长租期，常见搭配 sign a lease renewal、offer a lease renewal；正式多用该词，口语常说 renew the lease。

examples.en: The landlord sent me a lease renewal offer two months before my current lease expires.
examples.zh: 房东在当前租约到期前两个月给我发来了续租要约。

examples.en: If you want to stay in the same flat, you need to discuss a lease renewal with the property management company.
examples.zh: 如果你想继续住同一套公寓，需要和物业公司谈到期续租。

entries.shortAnswer: 租期的英语是 lease term，指租赁合同的有效期限。注意不要和 rental period 混淆，lease term 更强调合同法律条款中的期间。
entries.definition: lease term 常用于正式租房合同，指双方约定的租用时长，如一年或两年。常见搭配：a one-year lease term、renew the lease term。口语中也可用 rental period，但 lease term 更具法律意味。

examples.en: The lease term is twelve months, starting from June 1st.
examples.zh: 租期是十二个月，从六月一日起算。

examples.en: You can renew the lease term for another year if you want to stay.
examples.zh: 如果你想继续住，可以续签一年租期。

entries.shortAnswer: lease term 的中文是租期，即租赁合同的有效期限。它比 rental period 更正式，常见于书面合同，强调法律约束的时长。
entries.definition: lease term 指租约中约定的租用时间长度。常见搭配：a fixed lease term、the initial lease term。多用于正式书面合同；口语中常说 rental period。注意 lease term 不指具体租金或押金。

examples.en: The lease term is twelve months, starting from June 1st.
examples.zh: 租期是十二个月，从六月一日起算。

examples.en: You can renew the lease term for another year if you want to stay.
examples.zh: 如果你想继续住，可以续签一年租期。

entries.shortAnswer: 物业即 property management，指房屋及配套设施的日常管理服务。
entries.definition: 物业指小区或写字楼的日常管理服务，英文为 property management，如物业费、物业公司。

examples.en: The property management company handles all maintenance requests for the apartment building.
examples.zh: 这家物业公司负责处理公寓楼的所有维修申请。

examples.en: When renting a flat, ask whether the property management fee is included in the monthly rent.
examples.zh: 租房时，要问清楚物业费是否包含在月租里。

entries.shortAnswer: Property management means 物业, the daily care of buildings and facilities.
entries.definition: Property management is the daily administration of buildings and facilities, called 物业 in Chinese.

examples.en: The property management company handles all maintenance requests for the apartment building.
examples.zh: 这家物业公司负责处理公寓楼的所有维修申请。

examples.en: When renting a flat, ask whether the property management fee is included in the monthly rent.
examples.zh: 租房时，要问清楚物业费是否包含在月租里。

entries.shortAnswer: 「家具家电」的英文是 furniture and appliances。租房时常用，指房屋内配备的家具和电器，与「拎包入住」概念相关。
entries.definition: furniture and appliances 泛指家具和家电，常见于租房广告：带家具家电（furnished with furniture and appliances）。注意 furniture 不可数，appliances 含冰箱、洗衣机等。

examples.en: The apartment comes with furniture and appliances, so you can move in right away.
examples.zh: 这间公寓带家具家电，所以你可以直接拎包入住。

examples.en: Before you sign the lease, check the condition of all furniture and appliances to avoid deposit deductions.
examples.zh: 签租约前检查所有家具家电的状况，以免退租时押金被扣。

entries.shortAnswer: furniture and appliances 的中文意思是「家具家电」。它指家具和家用电器，常用于租房语境，与「拎包入住」对应。
entries.definition: furniture and appliances 是固定搭配，指家具和电器。英式英语中常用 white goods 指大型家电，但租房广告多用本词。注意 furniture 不可数，无复数形式。

examples.en: The apartment comes with furniture and appliances, so you can move in right away.
examples.zh: 这间公寓带家具家电，所以你可以直接拎包入住。

examples.en: Before you sign the lease, check the condition of all furniture and appliances to avoid deposit deductions.
examples.zh: 签租约前检查所有家具家电的状况，以免退租时押金被扣。

entries.shortAnswer: 「二房东」的英文是 subletting middleman，指整租后再分租赚差价的人。
entries.definition: subletting middleman 指从原房东整租后分租赚差价的人。常见搭配：找到、绕过二房东。风险：未经原房东同意转租易引发押金纠纷。

examples.en: Before signing the lease, ask whether the person is the landlord or just a subletting middleman.
examples.zh: 签合同前先问清楚对方是原房东还是二房东。

examples.en: Living with a subletting middleman can be cheaper, but your deposit may be at risk if the landlord never approved the sublet.
examples.zh: 跟二房东合租可能更便宜，但如果原房东没同意转租，你的押金可能有风险。

entries.shortAnswer: "Subletting middleman" is the English for 「二房东」: one who sublets rented rooms for profit.
entries.definition: A subletting middleman rents a flat then sublets rooms for profit, stressing the middleman role; unauthorized sublets risk deposit disputes.

examples.en: Before signing the lease, ask whether the person is the landlord or just a subletting middleman.
examples.zh: 签合同前先问清楚对方是原房东还是二房东。

examples.en: Living with a subletting middleman can be cheaper, but your deposit may be at risk if the landlord never approved the sublet.
examples.zh: 跟二房东合租可能更便宜，但如果原房东没同意转租，你的押金可能有风险。

entries.shortAnswer: 「做东」的英文就是 play the host，指自己出钱当主人请客。注意它强调掏钱待客，不是单纯到场陪客。
entries.definition: 做东指由自己付账、以东道主身份招待客人，常见搭配：play the host at dinner（做东请吃饭）。与 treat（请客）近义，但 play the host 更突出主人身份与全程张罗。

examples.en: Don't worry about the bill tonight—I'll play the host since it's my turn.
examples.zh: 今晚的账单不用管，轮到我做东了。

examples.en: He always likes to play the host when old classmates get together, which makes everyone feel at ease.
examples.zh: 老同学聚会他总是喜欢做东，让大家都很自在。

entries.shortAnswer: play the host 的中文意思就是「做东」，即自己出钱当主人招待客人。它与 treat 侧重付钱不同，更强调以东道主身份张罗全场。
entries.definition: play the host 意为做东、当东道主，多用于饭局、宴会等社交场合，语气中性偏口语。常见搭配：play the host at a dinner/party。易错点：它不表示「做客」，做客是 be a guest。

examples.en: Don't worry about the bill tonight—I'll play the host since it's my turn.
examples.zh: 今晚的账单不用管，轮到我做东了。

examples.en: He always likes to play the host when old classmates get together, which makes everyone feel at ease.
examples.zh: 老同学聚会他总是喜欢做东，让大家都很自在。

entries.shortAnswer: 网签合同的英文是 online lease contract，指通过政府租赁平台在线签署并备案的正式租房合同。
entries.definition: 网签合同强调线上签约与政府备案，区别于私下纸质合同。常见搭配：sign an online lease contract、file an online lease contract。注意押金、水电费结算。

examples.en: Before moving in, we signed an online lease contract through the local housing platform, so our security deposit is officially protected.
examples.zh: 搬进去之前，我们通过当地住房平台签了网签合同，所以押金受到官方保护。

examples.en: The landlord refused to sublet the apartment because the online lease contract explicitly prohibits it without written consent.
examples.zh: 房东拒绝转租这套公寓，因为网签合同明确禁止未经书面同意的转租行为。

entries.shortAnswer: online lease contract 的中文意思是网签合同，指通过官方租赁平台在线签署并备案的租房合同。
entries.definition: online lease contract 是正式用语，指在政府住房租赁平台或中介系统上签署的电子合同，具有法律效力。常见搭配：sign/file an online lease contract。

examples.en: Before moving in, we signed an online lease contract through the local housing platform, so our security deposit is officially protected.
examples.zh: 搬进去之前，我们通过当地住房平台签了网签合同，所以押金受到官方保护。

examples.en: The landlord refused to sublet the apartment because the online lease contract explicitly prohibits it without written consent.
examples.zh: 房东拒绝转租这套公寓，因为网签合同明确禁止未经书面同意的转租行为。

entries.shortAnswer: 「随礼」的英文是 cash gift at ceremonies，指在婚丧嫁娶等场合按当地行情和交情送出的现金红包。
entries.definition: 随礼指在红白喜事等场合送现金红包，金额随行情与交情浮动。常见搭配：随份子、随礼金、随了五百。

examples.en: At my cousin's wedding, I gave a cash gift at ceremonies according to the local custom.
examples.zh: 在我表弟的婚礼上，我按当地行情随了礼。

examples.en: In many Chinese families, giving a cash gift at ceremonies is a way to maintain social ties.
examples.zh: 在许多中国家庭，随礼是维系人情往来的一种方式。

entries.shortAnswer: cash gift at ceremonies 的中文意思是「随礼」，即在婚丧嫁娶等场合按惯例送出的礼金，金额随行情和关系定档。
entries.definition: cash gift at ceremonies 指中国红白喜事等场合的现金礼金。口语常说 cash gift 或 red envelope，特指仪式性场合，非普通礼物。

examples.en: At my cousin's wedding, I gave a cash gift at ceremonies according to the local custom.
examples.zh: 在我表弟的婚礼上，我按当地行情随了礼。

examples.en: In many Chinese families, giving a cash gift at ceremonies is a way to maintain social ties.
examples.zh: 在许多中国家庭，随礼是维系人情往来的一种方式。

entries.shortAnswer: 份子钱英文常说 gift money at weddings，指参加婚礼时给的现金礼金，是人情往来中需记账回礼的支出。
entries.definition: 搭配：give/pay gift money at weddings（随份子）。易错点：别直译成 wedding fee；强调现金时可用 cash gift。

examples.en: In China, guests usually give gift money at weddings instead of buying a present from a registry.
examples.zh: 在中国，宾客参加婚礼通常随份子钱，而不是从礼品清单上买礼物。

examples.en: My mother keeps a notebook to record how much gift money at weddings each relative gave, so she can return the favor later.
examples.zh: 我妈妈用本子记下每位亲戚随了多少份子钱，以便日后还礼。

entries.shortAnswer: Gift money at weddings 就是中文的份子钱，指参加婚礼时送的现金礼金，属人情往来，需记账日后回礼。
entries.definition: 解释性说法，指中国婚礼习俗中的现金礼金；口语也说 cash gift、red envelope。搭配：give/receive gift money at weddings。

examples.en: In China, guests usually give gift money at weddings instead of buying a present from a registry.
examples.zh: 在中国，宾客参加婚礼通常随份子钱，而不是从礼品清单上买礼物。

examples.en: My mother keeps a notebook to record how much gift money at weddings each relative gave, so she can return the favor later.
examples.zh: 我妈妈用本子记下每位亲戚随了多少份子钱，以便日后还礼。

entries.shortAnswer: 「伴手礼」的英文是 souvenir gift，特指旅行或做客后带回来送人的小礼物。注意它是可数名词，常搭配 bring back / give as a souvenir gift。
entries.definition: souvenir gift 强调「纪念性小礼物」，与普通 present 不同：它通常承载旅行地特色或心意，常用于探亲访友、商务往来。常见搭配：a local souvenir gift、bring a souvenir gift back。

examples.en: I brought a local souvenir gift back for my colleagues after the business trip.
examples.zh: 出差回来后，我给同事们带了当地伴手礼。

examples.en: When visiting a friend's home, it's polite to bring a small souvenir gift.
examples.zh: 去朋友家做客时，带一份小伴手礼是礼貌的做法。

entries.shortAnswer: souvenir gift 的中文意思是「伴手礼」，指旅行或访问后带回送人的小纪念品。它比普通 gift 更强调地域特色和「随手带回来」的意味。
entries.definition: souvenir gift 指带有当地特色、用于送人的小礼物，口语和书面均常用。搭配：buy a souvenir gift、bring a souvenir gift for sb。注意与 souvenir 区别：souvenir 可自留，souvenir gift 强调送人。

examples.en: I brought a local souvenir gift back for my colleagues after the business trip.
examples.zh: 出差回来后，我给同事们带了当地伴手礼。

examples.en: When visiting a friend's home, it's polite to bring a small souvenir gift.
examples.zh: 去朋友家做客时，带一份小伴手礼是礼貌的做法。

entries.shortAnswer: 「走亲戚」的英文是 visiting relatives，指逢年过节到亲戚家拜访。它不是 visiting，单说 visiting 只是「探望」，没有中文里节日串门的人情意味。
entries.definition: 常用复数 relatives，动词可用 visit relatives 或 go visiting relatives。春节等节庆语境里，走亲戚往往伴随送礼金、做东、敬酒、寒暄等礼数，如 go to visit relatives during Spring Festival。

examples.en: During the Spring Festival, we spend the first few days visiting relatives and exchanging red envelopes.
examples.zh: 春节期间，我们头几天都在走亲戚、互送红包。

examples.en: My parents are busy visiting relatives this week, so I'm staying home to look after the house.
examples.zh: 我爸妈这周忙着走亲戚，所以我留在家里看家。

entries.shortAnswer: visiting relatives 的中文意思是「走亲戚」，即逢年过节到亲戚家串门拜访。它强调节日间的礼尚往来，比单纯 visiting 多了份人情往来的味道。
entries.definition: visiting relatives 指到亲戚家探望串门，多用于春节等节庆场合，常与 during the Spring Festival 连用。口语也可说 seeing relatives，但 visiting 更突出专程登门、带上礼物的意味。

examples.en: During the Spring Festival, we spend the first few days visiting relatives and exchanging red envelopes.
examples.zh: 春节期间，我们头几天都在走亲戚、互送红包。

examples.en: My parents are busy visiting relatives this week, so I'm staying home to look after the house.
examples.zh: 我爸妈这周忙着走亲戚，所以我留在家里看家。

entries.shortAnswer: 「客套」的英文是 polite formula。用时要记住：客套多是礼节性说法，像「改天请你吃饭」往往不是真约，别当真。
entries.definition: polite formula 指社交中为维持和气、表达礼貌的固定话术，如寒暄、谦让、道谢。常见搭配 make polite formulas、exchange polite formulas。注意：客套有言外之意，不等于真心承诺。

examples.en: He said he would treat me to dinner sometime, but it was just a polite formula.
examples.zh: 他说改天请我吃饭，但那只是客套话。

examples.en: Chinese people often exchange polite formulas like "come over for tea when you're free" without meaning a real invitation.
examples.zh: 中国人常互说「有空来喝茶」这类客套话，并不一定是真邀请。

entries.shortAnswer: polite formula 的中文意思是「客套」，即礼节性的客套话。它重在维持社交面子，和单纯闲聊的 small talk 不同，常含未必当真的言外之意。
entries.definition: polite formula 指礼节场合的客套话，可搭配 use/exchange polite formulas。口语中常说「那只是客套话」。易错：它是社交润滑剂，听者不必把每句都当承诺。

examples.en: He said he would treat me to dinner sometime, but it was just a polite formula.
examples.zh: 他说改天请我吃饭，但那只是客套话。

examples.en: Chinese people often exchange polite formulas like "come over for tea when you're free" without meaning a real invitation.
examples.zh: 中国人常互说「有空来喝茶」这类客套话，并不一定是真邀请。

entries.shortAnswer: 回礼英文是 return gift，指收到礼物或礼金后回赠对方的礼物或行为，强调礼尚往来的传统习俗。
entries.definition: 回礼常用于婚礼、满月等场合，可指实物或礼金。搭配：give a return gift。注意 return gift 不是退货。

examples.en: In Chinese weddings, guests give cash gifts and the couple often gives a return gift such as candy or a small keepsake.
examples.zh: 在中国婚礼上，宾客送份子钱，新人通常会回礼，比如喜糖或小纪念品。

examples.en: When my neighbor brought over a housewarming present, I baked cookies as a return gift to keep the favor cycle going.
examples.zh: 邻居送来乔迁礼物后，我烤了饼干作为回礼，以维持礼尚往来的情分。

entries.shortAnswer: Return gift 中文意思是「回礼」，即收到礼物后回赠对方的礼物，强调礼尚往来的传统习俗。
entries.definition: Return gift 指对收到的礼物或礼金做出回赠。搭配：give a return gift。口语也可说 gift in return。

examples.en: In Chinese weddings, guests give cash gifts and the couple often gives a return gift such as candy or a small keepsake.
examples.zh: 在中国婚礼上，宾客送份子钱，新人通常会回礼，比如喜糖或小纪念品。

examples.en: When my neighbor brought over a housewarming present, I baked cookies as a return gift to keep the favor cycle going.
examples.zh: 邻居送来乔迁礼物后，我烤了饼干作为回礼，以维持礼尚往来的情分。

entries.shortAnswer: 「面子」的英文常用 face and social standing 来表达。日常口语里说 face 已足够，如 lose face 丢面子、save face 挽回面子。
entries.definition: 面子指个人尊严与社会地位，常与动词搭配：给面子、丢面子、留面子。社交场合用 face and social standing 更完整正式。

examples.en: In many Asian cultures, losing face and social standing can be more painful than losing money.
examples.zh: 在许多亚洲文化中，丢面子和失去社会地位比丢钱更难受。

examples.en: He offered a sincere apology to save her face and social standing in front of the whole team.
examples.zh: 他真诚道歉，以在全体团队面前挽回她的面子和尊严。

entries.shortAnswer: Face and social standing 的中文意思是「面子」，即个人尊严与社会地位，更依赖他人评价与社交互动。
entries.definition: Face and social standing 常出现在跨文化沟通、职场与人情往来语境，搭配有 lose face、save face、give face 等。

examples.en: In many Asian cultures, losing face and social standing can be more painful than losing money.
examples.zh: 在许多亚洲文化中，丢面子和失去社会地位比丢钱更难受。

examples.en: He offered a sincere apology to save her face and social standing in front of the whole team.
examples.zh: 他真诚道歉，以在全体团队面前挽回她的面子和尊严。

entries.shortAnswer: 「礼尚往来」英文说 courtesy demands reciprocity，指礼节要有来有往、对等回报，正式书面语。
entries.definition: 「礼尚往来」指人情礼节必须双向对等，收了好处要回报。英文 courtesy demands reciprocity 偏正式格言；口语多说 return the favor。

examples.en: When his colleague sent a wedding gift, he knew courtesy demands reciprocity and returned the kindness at her ceremony.
examples.zh: 同事给他送了结婚礼金，他深知礼尚往来，便在她办婚礼时回了礼。

examples.en: In many cultures, courtesy demands reciprocity, so refusing a toast without offering one back can seem impolite.
examples.zh: 在许多文化里讲究礼尚往来，所以敬酒时只受不回会显得不礼貌。

entries.shortAnswer: Courtesy demands reciprocity 意为「礼尚往来」，指礼节要求有来有往、对等回报，语气正式。
