entries.definition: Courtesy demands reciprocity 是正式格言，指人际礼数必须双向对等。口语常说 return the favor，更侧重具体回报行为。

examples.en: When his colleague sent a wedding gift, he knew courtesy demands reciprocity and returned the kindness at her ceremony.
examples.zh: 同事给他送了结婚礼金，他深知礼尚往来，便在她办婚礼时回了礼。

examples.en: In many cultures, courtesy demands reciprocity, so refusing a toast without offering one back can seem impolite.
examples.zh: 在许多文化里讲究礼尚往来，所以敬酒时只受不回会显得不礼貌。

entries.shortAnswer: 「串门」的英文是 drop by for a visit。它强调临时、非正式地到邻里或亲友家短坐聊天，不是正式拜访。
entries.definition: drop by for a visit 指没有预约、顺路到别人家坐坐，常与邻居、亲戚、朋友之间的人情往来搭配。注意它不同于正式拜访 pay a formal visit，也不等于 drop in on someone（后者可能略带打扰感）。

examples.en: My aunt often drops by for a visit on Sunday afternoons, bringing homemade snacks and chatting about family news.
examples.zh: 我姑姑经常在周日下午来串门，带些自制点心，聊聊家里的事。

examples.en: Since we live in the same neighborhood, we drop by for a visit whenever we have free time, sharing tea and small talk.
examples.zh: 因为我们住同一个小区，有空就会去串门，喝喝茶、寒暄几句。

entries.shortAnswer: drop by for a visit 的中文意思是「串门」。它指临时、非正式地去亲友或邻居家短坐聊天，不是正式拜访。
entries.definition: drop by for a visit 是口语化表达，强调顺路、不预约的短访；与 pay a visit 相比更随意，与 drop in on someone 相比更中性。常用于邻里、亲戚、朋友之间的人情走动。

examples.en: My aunt often drops by for a visit on Sunday afternoons, bringing homemade snacks and chatting about family news.
examples.zh: 我姑姑经常在周日下午来串门，带些自制点心，聊聊家里的事。

examples.en: Since we live in the same neighborhood, we drop by for a visit whenever we have free time, sharing tea and small talk.
examples.zh: 因为我们住同一个小区，有空就会去串门，喝喝茶、寒暄几句。

entries.shortAnswer: 「敬酒」的英文是 toast with liquor，指宴席上向长辈、领导或宾客举杯表敬意。英文 toast 本身只是举杯祝词，不含中式敬酒的等级与顺序感。
entries.definition: 常用搭配：toast with liquor to sb（向某人敬酒）。中式敬酒讲究杯沿低于对方、按尊卑长幼顺序进行，体现人情往来中的尊重；英文 toast 侧重举杯说祝词，无此等级含义。

examples.en: At the company dinner, the new employee stood up to toast with liquor to his boss, carefully keeping his glass lower than hers.
examples.zh: 公司晚宴上，新员工起身向老板敬酒，特意把杯沿放得比对方低。

examples.en: During the wedding banquet, the groom and bride went from table to table to toast with liquor to every guest as a gesture of gratitude.
examples.zh: 婚宴上，新郎新娘逐桌向每位宾客敬酒，以表感谢。

entries.shortAnswer: 「toast with liquor」的中文意思是「敬酒」，指宴席上向长辈、领导或宾客举杯表敬意。它比普通 toast 多了中式酒桌的等级秩序与礼仪色彩。
entries.definition: toast with liquor 对应中文「敬酒」，用于正式或人情往来的宴席场合，常搭配 to sb（向某人敬酒）。注意与普通 toast（举杯祝词）区别：后者无杯沿高低、敬酒顺序等中式礼仪。

examples.en: At the company dinner, the new employee stood up to toast with liquor to his boss, carefully keeping his glass lower than hers.
examples.zh: 公司晚宴上，新员工起身向老板敬酒，特意把杯沿放得比对方低。

examples.en: During the wedding banquet, the groom and bride went from table to table to toast with liquor to every guest as a gesture of gratitude.
examples.zh: 婚宴上，新郎新娘逐桌向每位宾客敬酒，以表感谢。

entries.shortAnswer: 寒暄的英文是 small talk greetings，指见面时说的客套话，多用于打招呼、暖场，不涉及实质内容。
entries.definition: 寒暄指见面时互相说客套话，如问好、聊天气。常用搭配：exchange small talk greetings（互相寒暄）。区别于 greetings 只指问候语，寒暄更强调你来我往的短暂交谈。

examples.en: Before the meeting started, we exchanged small talk greetings about the weather.
examples.zh: 会议开始前，我们聊了聊天气，寒暄了几句。

examples.en: He is good at making small talk greetings with clients at the dinner table.
examples.zh: 他很擅长在饭桌上与客户寒暄。

entries.shortAnswer: small talk greetings 的中文意思是寒暄，即见面时的客套问候，侧重轻松、非正式的简短交谈。
entries.definition: small talk greetings 指见面时非正式的客套寒暄，常见于社交、职场暖场。搭配：exchange small talk greetings（互相寒暄）。口语常用，正式场合可用 polite greetings。

examples.en: Before the meeting started, we exchanged small talk greetings about the weather.
examples.zh: 会议开始前，我们聊了聊天气，寒暄了几句。

examples.en: He is good at making small talk greetings with clients at the dinner table.
examples.zh: 他很擅长在饭桌上与客户寒暄。

entries.shortAnswer: 「托人带话」英文是 pass on a message，指请第三方转达口信。注意别直译成 let someone bring words，那不合英语习惯。
entries.definition: 常用搭配：pass on a message to sb。强调通过中间人传达，不是当面说；比 tell 更间接，比 relay 更口语。托人带话常含人情意味，对方帮你是给面子。

examples.en: Could you pass on a message to Lily for me? I have to leave early today.
examples.zh: 你能帮我给莉莉托人带个话吗？我今天得早走。

examples.en: He asked his assistant to pass on a message to the client about the meeting change.
examples.zh: 他让助理向客户托人带话，通知会议改期。

entries.shortAnswer: pass on a message 中文是「托人带话」，指请人代为转达口信。它与 relay information 近义，但更口语、更强调中间人帮忙。
entries.definition: to pass on a message 核心义为转达消息，常用于请第三方捎话。搭配：pass on a message to sb。比 forward 更生活化，比 tell 更间接，隐含欠下小人情。

examples.en: Could you pass on a message to Lily for me? I have to leave early today.
examples.zh: 你能帮我给莉莉托人带个话吗？我今天得早走。

examples.en: He asked his assistant to pass on a message to the client about the meeting change.
examples.zh: 他让助理向客户托人带话，通知会议改期。

entries.shortAnswer: 「占便宜」的英文是 take advantage，常指利用他人或机会为自己谋利。注意 take advantage of 后接人或机会，别和 take advantage 单独用混淆。
entries.definition: take advantage of sb 指占某人便宜、利用某人；take advantage of sth 指利用机会或资源。口语也常说 get the better of sb，但后者偏在竞争中占上风。

examples.en: Don't let him take advantage of your kindness; he's just trying to get a free ride.
examples.zh: 别让他占你善良的便宜，他不过是想白吃白拿。

examples.en: She took advantage of the sale to buy gifts for the whole family.
examples.zh: 她趁打折占便宜，给全家人都买了礼物。

entries.shortAnswer: Take advantage 的中文意思是「占便宜」，指利用他人、机会或弱点为自己谋利。它和 take advantage of 搭配使用，后接人或事物。
entries.definition: take advantage 常构成 take advantage of sb/sth：占某人便宜、利用机会。正式语境可指不当利用职权或信任，日常口语也指趁打折等占实惠。

examples.en: Don't let him take advantage of your kindness; he's just trying to get a free ride.
examples.zh: 别让他占你善良的便宜，他不过是想白吃白拿。

examples.en: She took advantage of the sale to buy gifts for the whole family.
examples.zh: 她趁打折占便宜，给全家人都买了礼物。

entries.shortAnswer: 「欠人情」的英语常用表达是 owe a favor，指受了别人的恩惠还没回报。但中文的欠人情有更重的心理负担，常暗含人情债，而英文 owe a favor 语气相对轻，更像欠一个具体帮助。
entries.definition: owe a favor 是动词短语，常用结构 owe sb a favor 或 owe a favor to sb。注意 favor 英式拼 favour。中文欠人情强调关系中的亏欠感，英语则常指具体帮忙。还人情可说 return a favor。

examples.en: I still owe him a favor for helping me move last month.
examples.zh: 上个月他帮我搬家，我还欠他一个人情。

examples.en: She doesn't like to owe a favor to anyone, so she always insists on paying people back.
examples.zh: 她不喜欢欠任何人的人情，所以总是坚持回报别人。

entries.shortAnswer: owe a favor 的中文意思是「欠人情」，即受了别人的帮助而觉得应该回报。但英文里更偏向欠一个具体的人情，中文「欠人情」还可以指熟人社会里长期的人情债。
entries.definition: owe a favor 表示欠某人一个人情，常用于日常和职场语境，结构为 owe sb a favor 或 owe a favor to sb。与 be in debt 相比，它更轻、更具体，不强调金钱债务。

examples.en: I still owe him a favor for helping me move last month.
examples.zh: 上个月他帮我搬家，我还欠他一个人情。

examples.en: She doesn't like to owe a favor to anyone, so she always insists on paying people back.
examples.zh: 她不喜欢欠任何人的人情，所以总是坚持回报别人。

entries.shortAnswer: 「客气」在表示婉拒时，英文常说 courteous refusal，指含蓄得体地回绝；口语更常用 politely decline。
entries.definition: 客气有两层：待人讲客套，以及委婉推辞邀请或馈赠。表示婉拒时用 courteous refusal，强调拒绝仍顾对方面子。

examples.en: She offered a courteous refusal to his repeated help, not wanting to owe him a favor.
examples.zh: 她客气地婉拒了他一再的帮忙，不想欠他人情。

examples.en: A courteous refusal at the dinner table is better than accepting a gift you cannot return.
examples.zh: 饭桌上客气地推辞，好过收下一份你还不起的礼。

entries.shortAnswer: courteous refusal 的中文意思是「客气」，特指委婉得体的拒绝，即婉拒，常用于回绝邀请与馈赠。
entries.definition: courteous refusal 指礼貌地谢绝，强调拒绝时不失礼、给对方留面子，多用于正式或半正式场合。

examples.en: She offered a courteous refusal to his repeated help, not wanting to owe him a favor.
examples.zh: 她客气地婉拒了他一再的帮忙，不想欠他人情。

examples.en: A courteous refusal at the dinner table is better than accepting a gift you cannot return.
examples.zh: 饭桌上客气地推辞，好过收下一份你还不起的礼。

entries.shortAnswer: 「推辞」的英文是 politely decline，但推辞是礼节性假意推让，politely decline 只表礼貌拒绝，少了仪式感。
entries.definition: 推辞指礼节性假意拒绝，常见于收礼、敬酒等场合：先推两下再接受，是给对方面子的流程。英文 politely decline 只强调礼貌拒绝，无推让仪式含义。

examples.en: When my colleague offered me a gift, I politely declined at first, but then accepted it after she insisted.
examples.zh: 同事送我礼物时，我起初推辞了一下，但在她坚持后还是收下了。

examples.en: He politely declined the toast at the banquet, but everyone knew it was just a ritual before he finally drank.
examples.zh: 宴会上他推辞了敬酒，但大家都知道这只是仪式，最终他还是喝了。

entries.shortAnswer: politely decline 的中文意思是「推辞」，但推辞是礼节性假意推让，politely decline 只表礼貌拒绝，缺少这层仪式感。
entries.definition: politely decline 意为礼貌拒绝，中文常译「推辞」。但推辞带有仪式性推让，常见于收礼、敬酒等场合；politely decline 往往是直接拒绝，推辞则可能最终接受。

examples.en: When my colleague offered me a gift, I politely declined at first, but then accepted it after she insisted.
examples.zh: 同事送我礼物时，我起初推辞了一下，但在她坚持后还是收下了。

examples.en: He politely declined the toast at the banquet, but everyone knew it was just a ritual before he finally drank.
examples.zh: 宴会上他推辞了敬酒，但大家都知道这只是仪式，最终他还是喝了。

entries.shortAnswer: 「捎东西」可译 bring something along for someone，指顺路替人带物。
entries.definition: 因自己也要去某地，顺路替别人把东西带过去；口语常用，正式可用 take something for sb。

examples.en: Could you bring something along for me when you come to the party? I left my gift at home.
examples.zh: 你来参加聚会时能帮我捎东西吗？我把礼物落家里了。

examples.en: She asked her neighbor to bring something along for someone, since he was already going to the post office.
examples.zh: 她请邻居帮人捎东西，因为他正好要去邮局。

entries.shortAnswer: bring something along for someone means 捎东西, to carry something for someone on the way.
entries.definition: To take something with you for someone because you are already going there; it stresses doing it on the way, not specially.

examples.en: Could you bring something along for me when you come to the party? I left my gift at home.
examples.zh: 你来参加聚会时能帮我捎东西吗？我把礼物落家里了。

examples.en: She asked her neighbor to bring something along for someone, since he was already going to the post office.
examples.zh: 她请邻居帮人捎东西，因为他正好要去邮局。

entries.shortAnswer: 「还人情」英文是 return a favor，指用等量或加码的方式偿还别人给过的帮助。注意它强调人情往来的闭环，不是单纯说谢谢，而是要有实际回报。
entries.definition: 常见说法有 return a favor、return the favor、repay a favor。人情讲究礼尚往来：今天你帮我、明天我帮你，欠了人情就要找机会还上，回报往往略大于所受的帮助。

examples.en: She helped me move last month, so I returned a favor by cooking dinner for her family.
examples.zh: 她上个月帮我搬家，所以我做了一顿饭请她家人，算是还了人情。

examples.en: In Chinese culture, people often return a favor with something a little more generous to keep the relationship going.
examples.zh: 在中国文化里，人们还人情时往往会稍微加码，以维持彼此的往来。

entries.shortAnswer: "Return a favor" 中文意思是「还人情」，指用等量或加码的方式回报别人曾经的帮助。它强调人情往来的循环，与单纯道谢不同，通常需要实际行动。
entries.definition: to return a favor 意为回报他人的恩惠，常见搭配 return the favor、repay a favor。口语和正式场合都可用；注意它侧重礼尚往来的对等回报，而非空口致谢。

examples.en: She helped me move last month, so I returned a favor by cooking dinner for her family.
examples.zh: 她上个月帮我搬家，所以我做了一顿饭请她家人，算是还了人情。

examples.en: In Chinese culture, people often return a favor with something a little more generous to keep the relationship going.
examples.zh: 在中国文化里，人们还人情时往往会稍微加码，以维持彼此的往来。

entries.shortAnswer: 「求人办事」的英文是 ask for help through connections，指托熟人、找关系把事情办成。它常含一丝灰色意味，暗示不走正常流程而靠人情。
entries.definition: 贬义色彩取决于语境：中性时指正常求助熟人，负面时暗含走后门、破坏公平。近义表达 pull strings 更强调幕后操纵，go through connections 偏口语。

examples.en: He had to ask for help through connections to get his son into that school.
examples.zh: 为了让儿子进那所学校，他不得不求人办事。

examples.en: Rather than ask for help through connections, she followed the official procedure step by step.
examples.zh: 她没有求人办事，而是一步步走正式流程。

entries.shortAnswer: ask for help through connections 的中文意思是「求人办事」，即托熟人、找关系把事办成。它与 pull strings 的关键区别是后者更强调幕后操纵、语感更灰。
entries.definition: 指借助私人关系而非正式渠道获取帮助，多用于办事、求职、就医等场景。语感中性偏灰，正式场合可用 go through connections 委婉表达，避免直译 ask someone to do things。

examples.en: He had to ask for help through connections to get his son into that school.
examples.zh: 为了让儿子进那所学校，他不得不求人办事。

examples.en: Rather than ask for help through connections, she followed the official procedure step by step.
examples.zh: 她没有求人办事，而是一步步走正式流程。

entries.shortAnswer: 「随份子」的英文是 chip in a cash gift，指亲友办婚丧喜事时凑份子钱，强调出钱这个动作。
entries.definition: 婚丧喜庆场合凑现金礼金，常说 chip in a cash gift for someone's wedding。易错点：chip in 泛指凑钱，加 a cash gift 才落到份子钱。

examples.en: My colleagues and I chipped in a cash gift for the manager's wedding.
examples.zh: 我和同事们一起随了份子，给经理的婚礼凑了礼金。

examples.en: In China, guests usually chip in a cash gift instead of bringing a wrapped present.
examples.zh: 在中国，宾客通常是随份子给礼金，而不是带包装好的礼物。

entries.shortAnswer: chip in a cash gift 中文意思是「随份子」，即亲友办事时出一份礼金，强调凑钱的动作。
entries.definition: 口语常用，指在婚礼、满月等场合凑一笔现金礼金。常说 chip in a cash gift for the newlyweds。易错点：chip in 单独用是凑钱，加 a cash gift 才明确是随份子。

examples.en: My colleagues and I chipped in a cash gift for the manager's wedding.
examples.zh: 我和同事们一起随了份子，给经理的婚礼凑了礼金。

examples.en: In China, guests usually chip in a cash gift instead of bringing a wrapped present.
examples.zh: 在中国，宾客通常是随份子给礼金，而不是带包装好的礼物。

entries.shortAnswer: 随大流用英语说是 follow the crowd，指不假思索地跟着多数人走，常含贬义，暗示缺乏主见。
entries.definition: follow the crowd 指因从众心理而跟随大众，可用于消费、穿搭、观点或人情往来。注意 crowd 前必须加 the；它比 follow the trend 更强调盲从、没主见，口语常用。

examples.en: At the wedding, I didn't want to follow the crowd and give a huge red envelope, but in the end I did it anyway to avoid losing face.
examples.zh: 婚礼上我不想随大流包个大红包，但最后还是照做了，免得丢面子。

examples.en: When everyone at the dinner table stood up to toast, he followed the crowd even though he barely knew the host.
examples.zh: 饭桌上大家都起身敬酒时，他也随大流站了起来，尽管他跟主人并不熟。

entries.shortAnswer: follow the crowd 的中文意思是随大流，指跟着大多数人的做法走，常含贬义，暗示没有自己的判断。
entries.definition: follow the crowd 是动词短语，意为从众、随大流，多用于口语。注意不能说 follow crowd，必须加 the；它侧重人的盲从，而 follow the trend 更中性。

examples.en: At the wedding, I didn't want to follow the crowd and give a huge red envelope, but in the end I did it anyway to avoid losing face.
examples.zh: 婚礼上我不想随大流包个大红包，但最后还是照做了，免得丢面子。

examples.en: When everyone at the dinner table stood up to toast, he followed the crowd even though he barely knew the host.
examples.zh: 饭桌上大家都起身敬酒时，他也随大流站了起来，尽管他跟主人并不熟。

entries.shortAnswer: 「捧场」用英语说就是 show up to support，指亲自到场支持某人或某活动，带人情意味。
entries.definition: 捧场指出于人情或支持亲自到场，给活动凑人气、给主人面子，英语常用 show up to support。

examples.en: My friend is opening a small restaurant this weekend, so I promised to show up to support him.
examples.zh: 我朋友这周末开一家小餐馆，所以我答应去给他捧场。

examples.en: Even though she was tired, she still showed up to support her sister at the piano recital.
examples.zh: 虽然她很累，还是去给妹妹的钢琴演奏会捧场了。

entries.shortAnswer: show up to support 的中文意思是「捧场」，指亲自到场支持，带人情意味，不是单纯表态。
entries.definition: show up to support 多用于口语，强调人到现场为某人或活动捧场，常见搭配 a friend/event。

examples.en: My friend is opening a small restaurant this weekend, so I promised to show up to support him.
examples.zh: 我朋友这周末开一家小餐馆，所以我答应去给他捧场。

examples.en: Even though she was tired, she still showed up to support her sister at the piano recital.
examples.zh: 虽然她很累，还是去给妹妹的钢琴演奏会捧场了。

entries.shortAnswer: 打圆场用英语说是 smooth things over，指在尴尬或争吵中出面调和、化解矛盾，不等于正式道歉。
entries.definition: smooth things over 常与 try to、help 连用，用于人际摩擦、饭局冷场等场合；侧重缓和局面，而非替人认错或撒谎掩饰。

examples.en: When the two colleagues started arguing at dinner, the manager tried to smooth things over with a joke.
examples.zh: 两位同事在饭桌上吵起来时，经理用一句玩笑打了圆场。

examples.en: She invited both families to lunch to smooth things over after the misunderstanding about the wedding gift.
examples.zh: 关于婚礼礼金的误会之后，她请两家人吃午饭，想缓和一下关系。

entries.shortAnswer: smooth things over 的中文意思是打圆场，即为争吵或尴尬的双方调和、把局面缓和下来，但不等于正式道歉。
entries.definition: smooth things over 指用言语或行动缓解冲突与尴尬，常见搭配 smooth things over with sb；偏口语，多用于亲友同事之间。

examples.en: When the two colleagues started arguing at dinner, the manager tried to smooth things over with a joke.
examples.zh: 两位同事在饭桌上吵起来时，经理用一句玩笑打了圆场。

examples.en: She invited both families to lunch to smooth things over after the misunderstanding about the wedding gift.
examples.zh: 关于婚礼礼金的误会之后，她请两家人吃午饭，想缓和一下关系。

entries.shortAnswer: 「网约车」英文是 ride-hailing car，指用手机应用在线预约的载客汽车。
entries.definition: ride-hailing car 指通过滴滴、Uber 等平台在线预约的车。常见搭配：call a ride-hailing car。注意顺风车、拼车说法不同。

examples.en: I usually call a ride-hailing car instead of taking a taxi because it's cheaper off-peak.
examples.zh: 我通常叫网约车而不是打出租车，因为非高峰时段网约车更便宜。

examples.en: The ride-hailing car arrived in three minutes, but surge pricing doubled the fare.
examples.zh: 网约车三分钟就到了，但动态加价让车费翻了一倍。

entries.shortAnswer: A ride-hailing car is 网约车 in Chinese: a car booked through an app, not hailed on the street.
entries.definition: A ride-hailing car is booked via apps like Didi or Uber. Common collocations: call a ride-hailing car, ride-hailing service.

examples.en: I usually call a ride-hailing car instead of taking a taxi because it's cheaper off-peak.
examples.zh: 我通常叫网约车而不是打出租车，因为非高峰时段网约车更便宜。

examples.en: The ride-hailing car arrived in three minutes, but surge pricing doubled the fare.
examples.zh: 网约车三分钟就到了，但动态加价让车费翻了一倍。

entries.shortAnswer: 「顺风车」英文说 carpool ride，指分摊油费过路费的非营利合乘出行方式。
entries.definition: carpool ride 指非营利性合乘出行，乘客分摊油费和过路费，与以盈利为目的的网约车 ride-hailing 不同。

examples.en: I took a carpool ride to the airport to save money on gas and tolls.
examples.zh: 为了省油费和过路费，我搭顺风车去了机场。

examples.en: She offers a carpool ride to work every morning, and her neighbors split the cost.
examples.zh: 她每天早上提供上班顺风车，邻居们分摊费用。

entries.shortAnswer: A carpool ride, or 顺风车 in Chinese, is a shared trip splitting fuel and toll costs.
entries.definition: A carpool ride is a shared, non-profit car trip where riders split fuel and tolls, unlike for-profit ride-hailing.

examples.en: I took a carpool ride to the airport to save money on gas and tolls.
examples.zh: 为了省油费和过路费，我搭顺风车去了机场。

examples.en: She offers a carpool ride to work every morning, and her neighbors split the cost.
examples.zh: 她每天早上提供上班顺风车，邻居们分摊费用。

entries.shortAnswer: 「上车点」的英文是 pickup point，指司机与乘客约定碰头上车的位置，和 drop-off point（下车点）相对。
entries.definition: pickup point 多用于网约车、顺风车、机场接人场景，如 set/change the pickup point。请注意它与泛指上客区的 pickup area 略有不同。

examples.en: Please set the pickup point at the north exit of the mall so the driver can find you easily.
examples.zh: 请把上车点设在商场北出口，这样司机更容易找到你。

examples.en: During rush hour, the driver asked me to walk to a nearby pickup point because the original one was too congested.
examples.zh: 高峰时段，司机让我走到附近的上车点，因为原来的上车点太堵了。

entries.shortAnswer: pickup point 的中文意思是「上车点」，即司机与乘客约好碰头上车的地点，与 drop-off point（下车点）相对。
entries.definition: pickup point 指约定的上车汇合位置，常见于打车、顺风车、机场接人场景，搭配 set/choose/change the pickup point，口语也可说 pickup spot。

examples.en: Please set the pickup point at the north exit of the mall so the driver can find you easily.
examples.zh: 请把上车点设在商场北出口，这样司机更容易找到你。

examples.en: During rush hour, the driver asked me to walk to a nearby pickup point because the original one was too congested.
examples.zh: 高峰时段，司机让我走到附近的上车点，因为原来的上车点太堵了。

entries.shortAnswer: 「摇号」英文是 license plate lottery，指抽签获取购车指标；上海用拍牌 auction。
entries.definition: 摇号指政府用随机抽签分配购车指标。搭配：win the license plate lottery、enter the lottery。

examples.en: I entered the license plate lottery three years ago but still haven't won a quota.
examples.zh: 我三年前就参加了摇号，但到现在还没摇中指标。

examples.en: Winning the license plate lottery is like winning the actual lottery, given how low the odds are.
examples.zh: 考虑到中签率极低，摇中车牌简直跟中彩票一样。

entries.shortAnswer: License plate lottery is 摇号, a random draw for car purchase quotas, unlike an auction.
entries.definition: License plate lottery means 摇号: a government random draw for car plates. Collocations: win/enter the lottery.

examples.en: I entered the license plate lottery three years ago but still haven't won a quota.
examples.zh: 我三年前就参加了摇号，但到现在还没摇中指标。

examples.en: Winning the license plate lottery is like winning the actual lottery, given how low the odds are.
examples.zh: 考虑到中签率极低，摇中车牌简直跟中彩票一样。

entries.shortAnswer: 「限号」英文是 license plate restriction，指工作日按车牌尾号限制部分车辆上路。
entries.definition: 常见搭配：implement license plate restriction（实施限号）、lift the restriction（解除限号）。注意与 odd-even rationing（单双号限行）区分。

examples.en: Beijing's license plate restriction means I can't drive my car on Mondays because the last digit is 1.
examples.zh: 北京的限号规定意味着我周一不能开车，因为我的车牌尾号是1。

examples.en: During the license plate restriction, many commuters turn to ride-hailing apps like Didi or carpool rides to get to work.
examples.zh: 限号期间，许多通勤者转而使用滴滴等网约车或拼车出行。

entries.shortAnswer: License plate restriction is 限号, banning cars on workdays by plate's last digit.
entries.definition: Key meaning: a policy that bans certain vehicles from roads based on the last digit of their license plate. Also called plate restriction.

examples.en: Beijing's license plate restriction means I can't drive my car on Mondays because the last digit is 1.
examples.zh: 北京的限号规定意味着我周一不能开车，因为我的车牌尾号是1。

examples.en: During the license plate restriction, many commuters turn to ride-hailing apps like Didi or carpool rides to get to work.
examples.zh: 限号期间，许多通勤者转而使用滴滴等网约车或拼车出行。

entries.shortAnswer: 「动态加价」的英文是 surge pricing，常用于网约车在高峰或需求大时上调价格。注意它指平台临时调价，不是普通涨价，也不用于实体店长期提价。
entries.definition: surge pricing 多指 Uber、滴滴等网约车平台在高峰期临时上调价格，如 during surge pricing。不要与 price gouging（哄抬物价）混用，后者含贬义。

examples.en: During rush hour, the ride-hailing app uses surge pricing, so the fare can be twice the normal price.
examples.zh: 在高峰期，网约车应用会采用动态加价，所以车费可能是正常价格的两倍。

examples.en: If you don't want to pay surge pricing, you can wait a few minutes or choose a carpool ride instead.
examples.zh: 如果你不想支付动态加价，可以等几分钟或选择拼车。

entries.shortAnswer: 「surge pricing」的中文意思是「动态加价」，指网约车在需求高峰时临时提高价格。它强调平台算法临时调价，与普通长期涨价不同。
entries.definition: surge pricing 是网约车行业术语，常见搭配有 during surge pricing、surge pricing kicks in。口语中也可说 surge。注意它不同于固定涨价，通常只持续高峰时段。

examples.en: During rush hour, the ride-hailing app uses surge pricing, so the fare can be twice the normal price.
examples.zh: 在高峰期，网约车应用会采用动态加价，所以车费可能是正常价格的两倍。

examples.en: If you don't want to pay surge pricing, you can wait a few minutes or choose a carpool ride instead.
examples.zh: 如果你不想支付动态加价，可以等几分钟或选择拼车。

entries.shortAnswer: 「拼车」的英文是 ride sharing，指多人共乘分摊费用，侧重平台撮合、临时短途。
entries.definition: ride sharing 指通过平台或熟人共用车辆、分摊费用，常见搭配 a ride sharing app、ride sharing service，强调临时分摊，与 carpool 的固定通勤不同。

examples.en: Ride sharing is much cheaper than taking a taxi alone, so I use a ride sharing app almost every day.
examples.zh: 拼车比独自打车便宜多了，所以我几乎每天都用一个拼车软件。

examples.en: During rush hour, ride sharing can save you both time and money compared with driving solo.
examples.zh: 高峰时段，拼车和独自开车相比既能省时间又能省钱。

entries.shortAnswer: ride sharing 的中文意思是「拼车」，即多人共乘分摊车费，强调平台撮合、临时短途。
entries.definition: ride sharing 指乘客共享车辆、分摊车费的出行方式，常见于网约车语境，如 a ride sharing app；它与 carpool 的日常轮流开车不同。

examples.en: Ride sharing is much cheaper than taking a taxi alone, so I use a ride sharing app almost every day.
examples.zh: 拼车比独自打车便宜多了，所以我几乎每天都用一个拼车软件。

examples.en: During rush hour, ride sharing can save you both time and money compared with driving solo.
examples.zh: 高峰时段，拼车和独自开车相比既能省时间又能省钱。

entries.shortAnswer: 「驾照」的英文是 driver license（美式），英式常写作 driving licence，用于证明驾驶资格。
entries.definition: 美式拼写 driver license 或 driver's license，英式拼写 driving licence，指驾驶机动车的法定许可。

examples.en: You need to show your driver license when you pick up a rental car.
examples.zh: 租车取车时你需要出示驾照。

examples.en: He got a traffic violation and points were deducted from his driver license.
examples.zh: 他违章了，驾照被扣了分。

entries.shortAnswer: Driver license 的中文意思是「驾照」，即允许持有人驾驶机动车的官方证件。
entries.definition: 美式拼写 driver license 或 driver's license，英式拼写 driving licence，指官方颁发的驾驶执照。

examples.en: You need to show your driver license when you pick up a rental car.
examples.zh: 租车取车时你需要出示驾照。

examples.en: He got a traffic violation and points were deducted from his driver license.
examples.zh: 他违章了，驾照被扣了分。

entries.shortAnswer: 「扣分」的英文是 license points deduction，指交通违章后驾照被记分。注意口语里常说 get points on my license，而不是直接说 deduct points。
entries.definition: license points deduction 多用于正式说明或政策描述，如驾照记分制度。日常口语更常说 get points、receive a points deduction，搭配违章类型：speeding、running a red light 等。

examples.en: Driving without a seatbelt can lead to a license points deduction in many places.
examples.zh: 在很多地方，不系安全带驾驶会导致驾照扣分。

examples.en: After his second speeding ticket, he faced a license points deduction and higher insurance rates.
examples.zh: 在第二次超速罚单之后，他面临驾照扣分和更高的保险费率。

entries.shortAnswer: License points deduction 的中文意思是「扣分」，指交通违章后驾照被记分的处罚。它强调记分制度本身，而不同于单纯的罚款 fine。
entries.definition: license points deduction 是正式说法，指驾照因违章被记分。常见于保险、交规说明；口语常说 get points on one's license。注意它不等于吊销驾照 suspension。

examples.en: Driving without a seatbelt can lead to a license points deduction in many places.
examples.zh: 在很多地方，不系安全带驾驶会导致驾照扣分。

examples.en: After his second speeding ticket, he faced a license points deduction and higher insurance rates.
examples.zh: 在第二次超速罚单之后，他面临驾照扣分和更高的保险费率。

entries.shortAnswer: 「科目二」英文是 driving test course two，指中国驾照考试的场地驾驶技能考试。
entries.definition: driving test course two 即科目二，中国驾照考试第二部分，考倒车入库、侧方停车等场地驾驶技能。

examples.en: My cousin failed driving test course two twice because of the reverse parking section, which is notoriously difficult.
examples.zh: 我表弟因为倒车入库这个特别难的部分，科目二挂了两次。

examples.en: Before you can book driving test course two, you need to pass the theory test and complete enough practice hours.
examples.zh: 在预约科目二之前，你需要通过理论考试并完成足够的练车学时。

entries.shortAnswer: driving test course two 就是「科目二」，指中国驾照考试中的第二部分场地驾驶技能考试。
entries.definition: driving test course two means 科目二, the second part of China's driving test, covering reverse parking and other closed-course skills.

examples.en: My cousin failed driving test course two twice because of the reverse parking section, which is notoriously difficult.
examples.zh: 我表弟因为倒车入库这个特别难的部分，科目二挂了两次。

examples.en: Before you can book driving test course two, you need to pass the theory test and complete enough practice hours.
examples.zh: 在预约科目二之前，你需要通过理论考试并完成足够的练车学时。

entries.shortAnswer: 「违章」的英文是 traffic violation，指违反交通法规的行为，比如闯红灯、超速或违停。
entries.definition: traffic violation 指违反交通法规，如闯红灯、超速、违停；常搭配 commit a traffic violation，收到罚单可用 get a ticket。

examples.en: The driver was fined for a traffic violation after running a red light.
examples.zh: 那名司机因闯红灯违章被罚款。

examples.en: Too many traffic violations will lead to points deduction on your license.
examples.zh: 违章太多会导致驾照被扣分。

entries.shortAnswer: traffic violation 的中文意思是「违章」，即违反交通规则的行为，如闯红灯、超速或违停。
entries.definition: traffic violation 是较正式说法，指闯红灯、超速、违停等违反交通规则的行为；口语常说 ticket，常见搭配 commit a traffic violation。

examples.en: The driver was fined for a traffic violation after running a red light.
examples.zh: 那名司机因闯红灯违章被罚款。

examples.en: Too many traffic violations will lead to points deduction on your license.
examples.zh: 违章太多会导致驾照被扣分。

entries.shortAnswer: 充电桩的英文是 EV charging station，也常说 charging station，指给电动汽车补充电量的固定设施。
entries.definition: EV charging station 是充电桩最通用的英文说法，日常也常说 charging station。常见搭配有 find an EV charging station、public charging station。

examples.en: We need to find an EV charging station before the battery runs out.
examples.zh: 我们得在电池耗尽前找到一个充电桩。

examples.en: This EV charging station supports fast charging, so a short stop is enough.
examples.zh: 这个充电桩支持快充，所以短暂停一下就够了。

entries.shortAnswer: EV charging station 的中文意思是充电桩，指为电动汽车提供充电服务的设施。
entries.definition: EV charging station 指给电动汽车充电的固定设施，中文常说充电桩。常见搭配有 public EV charging station、fast charging station。

examples.en: We need to find an EV charging station before the battery runs out.
examples.zh: 我们得在电池耗尽前找到一个充电桩。

examples.en: This EV charging station supports fast charging, so a short stop is enough.
examples.zh: 这个充电桩支持快充，所以短暂停一下就够了。

entries.shortAnswer: 「罚单」英文是 traffic ticket，指交通违章后收到的处罚通知，通常需要缴纳罚款。
entries.definition: traffic ticket 指因超速、闯红灯等违章被开出的交通罚单，需缴纳罚款。常见搭配：get a traffic ticket、pay a traffic ticket。

examples.en: I got a traffic ticket for speeding while driving to the airport.
examples.zh: 我开车去机场时因超速吃了一张罚单。

examples.en: If you don't pay the traffic ticket on time, the fine may increase.
examples.zh: 如果你不按时缴纳罚单，罚款可能会增加。

entries.shortAnswer: Traffic ticket means 罚单 in Chinese: a notice you pay for breaking traffic rules while driving.
entries.definition: A traffic ticket is a fine for a driving offense like speeding. Common: get/pay a traffic ticket. Not just a parking ticket.

examples.en: I got a traffic ticket for speeding while driving to the airport.
examples.zh: 我开车去机场时因超速吃了一张罚单。

examples.en: If you don't pay the traffic ticket on time, the fine may increase.
examples.zh: 如果你不按时缴纳罚单，罚款可能会增加。

entries.shortAnswer: 「代驾」的英文是 designated driver service，指酒后由专业司机替你开自己的车。
entries.definition: designated driver service 指专业司机代客户驾驶其本人车辆的付费服务，常见搭配 call a designated driver service。

examples.en: After the company party, I booked a designated driver service to take me and my car home safely.
examples.zh: 公司聚会后，我叫了代驾，把我和我的车安全送回家。

examples.en: Many ride-hailing apps like Didi now also offer a designated driver service with surge pricing during holidays.
examples.zh: 滴滴等许多网约车应用现在也提供代驾服务，节假日常有动态加价。

entries.shortAnswer: A designated driver service means 代驾: a paid driver who drives your own car home for you.
entries.definition: A designated driver service sends a professional to drive your own car, often after drinking; contrast it with a taxi or ride-hailing.

examples.en: After the company party, I booked a designated driver service to take me and my car home safely.
examples.zh: 公司聚会后，我叫了代驾，把我和我的车安全送回家。

examples.en: Many ride-hailing apps like Didi now also offer a designated driver service with surge pricing during holidays.
examples.zh: 滴滴等许多网约车应用现在也提供代驾服务，节假日常有动态加价。

entries.shortAnswer: 「高速免费」英文说 toll-free highway days，指节假日免收高速通行费，别与免电话费混淆。
entries.definition: 中国法定节假日期间，7 座及以下小客车免收高速公路通行费的政策，打车自驾常会提到，能省一笔路费。

examples.en: During toll-free highway days, many ride-hailing drivers avoid the expressway because of heavy traffic.
examples.zh: 高速免费期间，很多网约车司机因为堵车而避免走高速。

examples.en: If your carpool falls on toll-free highway days, the driver may lower the shared cost since the toll is waived.
examples.zh: 如果你的顺风车赶上高速免费，司机可能会因为免过路费而降低分摊费用。

entries.shortAnswer: Toll-free highway days means 「高速免费」: holidays when China waives highway tolls for small cars.
entries.definition: In China, statutory holidays when highway tolls are waived for small passenger cars, often mentioned by drivers and ride-hailing users.

examples.en: During toll-free highway days, many ride-hailing drivers avoid the expressway because of heavy traffic.
examples.zh: 高速免费期间，很多网约车司机因为堵车而避免走高速。

examples.en: If your carpool falls on toll-free highway days, the driver may lower the shared cost since the toll is waived.
examples.zh: 如果你的顺风车赶上高速免费，司机可能会因为免过路费而降低分摊费用。

entries.shortAnswer: 起步价在英语中通常说 base fare，指上车后计价器开始计费的固定最低金额。
entries.definition: base fare 指打车或网约车中，乘客上车后开始计费的最低固定金额，不含里程费、时长费和动态加价。中文常说“起步价”，英文也偶用 minimum fare，但 base fare 更强调计价结构中的基础部分。

examples.en: The base fare for this ride-hailing app is five yuan, and then it adds mileage and time fees.
examples.zh: 这个网约车应用的起步价是五元，然后再加上里程费和时长费。

examples.en: During surge pricing, the base fare stays the same, but the multiplier applies to the whole fare.
examples.zh: 在动态加价期间，起步价保持不变，但加价倍数会作用于整个车费。

entries.shortAnswer: base fare 的中文意思是起步价，即出租车或网约车开始计费时的固定最低费用。
entries.definition: base fare 指乘客上车后计价器开始计费的最低固定费用，不含里程费、时长费和动态加价。常见搭配有 pay the base fare、base fare plus mileage，注意别和 total fare 混淆。

examples.en: The base fare for this ride-hailing app is five yuan, and then it adds mileage and time fees.
examples.zh: 这个网约车应用的起步价是五元，然后再加上里程费和时长费。

examples.en: During surge pricing, the base fare stays the same, but the multiplier applies to the whole fare.
examples.zh: 在动态加价期间，起步价保持不变，但加价倍数会作用于整个车费。

entries.shortAnswer: 司机接单英文是 driver accepts the ride，用于网约车场景，指司机在平台接受乘客订单，接单后通常会联系乘客。
entries.definition: 司机接单即 driver accepts the ride，指网约车司机在平台接受乘客订单。注意与 pick up the passenger（接到乘客）不同，接单只是接单，接到人才是上车。

examples.en: After the driver accepts the ride, you can see the car's location and estimated arrival time on the app.
examples.zh: 司机接单后，你可以在应用上看到车辆位置和预计到达时间。

examples.en: If the driver accepts the ride but then cancels, the platform may charge a cancellation fee.
examples.zh: 如果司机接单后又取消，平台可能会收取取消费用。

entries.shortAnswer: driver accepts the ride 中文意思是司机接单，指网约车司机在应用上接受订单，与 pick up the passenger 不同。
entries.definition: driver accepts the ride 指司机接单，常见于滴滴、Uber 等网约车场景。接单后司机可联系乘客或前往上车点，注意不是接到乘客。

examples.en: After the driver accepts the ride, you can see the car's location and estimated arrival time on the app.
examples.zh: 司机接单后，你可以在应用上看到车辆位置和预计到达时间。

examples.en: If the driver accepts the ride but then cancels, the platform may charge a cancellation fee.
examples.zh: 如果司机接单后又取消，平台可能会收取取消费用。

entries.shortAnswer: 「等红灯」的英文是 wait at the red light，指在路口红灯亮起时停车等待，强调停在红灯前等待。
entries.definition: wait at the red light 常用于打车自驾场景，司机说 I'm waiting at the red light 表示正停在路口等灯。注意 light 前用 the 或 a 均可。

examples.en: The driver said he was waiting at the red light and would be there in two minutes.
examples.zh: 司机说他在等红灯，两分钟后到。

examples.en: We waited at the red light for almost a minute before it turned green.
examples.zh: 我们在红灯前等了将近一分钟才变绿。

entries.shortAnswer: wait at the red light 的中文意思是「等红灯」，即在路口遇红灯时停车等待，强调停在红灯前。
entries.definition: wait at the red light 是打车自驾常用表达，指车辆在红灯前停住等待。口语中也可说 wait at a red light 或 sit at the red light。

examples.en: The driver said he was waiting at the red light and would be there in two minutes.
examples.zh: 司机说他在等红灯，两分钟后到。

examples.en: We waited at the red light for almost a minute before it turned green.
examples.zh: 我们在红灯前等了将近一分钟才变绿。

entries.shortAnswer: 行车记录仪的英文是 dash cam，正式说法也可用 dash camera。dash cam 是口语和网购搜索里的高频词，别直译成 driving recorder。
entries.definition: dash cam 指装在挡风玻璃下、持续录制前方路况的车载摄像头。常见搭配：install a dash cam（安装行车记录仪）、dash cam footage（行车记录仪画面）。网约车司机常靠它应对碰瓷和违章争议。

examples.en: The ride-hailing driver installed a dash cam to protect himself from traffic violation disputes.
examples.zh: 那位网约车司机装了行车记录仪，以防违章纠纷说不清。

examples.en: The dash cam footage proved the carpool driver was not at fault in the accident.
examples.zh: 行车记录仪画面证明，那位顺风车司机在这起事故中没有责任。

entries.shortAnswer: dash cam 的中文意思是行车记录仪，指装在车内持续拍摄前方路况的摄像头。它不等于监控摄像头，强调车载、随车行驶录制，而非固定安防监控。
entries.definition: dash cam 由 dashboard camera 缩略而来，口语常用，正式写作可说 dash camera。常见搭配：a dash cam video、caught on dash cam。注意别与 security camera、body cam 混用。

examples.en: The ride-hailing driver installed a dash cam to protect himself from traffic violation disputes.
examples.zh: 那位网约车司机装了行车记录仪，以防违章纠纷说不清。

examples.en: The dash cam footage proved the carpool driver was not at fault in the accident.
examples.zh: 行车记录仪画面证明，那位顺风车司机在这起事故中没有责任。

entries.shortAnswer: 「挪车」的英文是 move a parked car，指请人把停着的车移开，不是 drive a car。
entries.definition: move a parked car 指把已停好的车移到别处，常用于车挡路或占车位时请人挪车。

examples.en: Excuse me, could you move a parked car? It's blocking my driveway.
examples.zh: 打扰一下，您能挪一下车吗？它挡住我的车道了。

examples.en: The driver had to move a parked car before the passenger could get in.
examples.zh: 乘客上车前，司机不得不先挪开一辆停着的车。

entries.shortAnswer: 「move a parked car」的中文是「挪车」，指把停着的车移开，车原本停着，不是行驶。
entries.definition: move a parked car 意为挪车，即把已停放的车移到别处，多因挡路或占位，不等于 drive away。

examples.en: Excuse me, could you move a parked car? It's blocking my driveway.
examples.zh: 打扰一下，您能挪一下车吗？它挡住我的车道了。

examples.en: The driver had to move a parked car before the passenger could get in.
examples.zh: 乘客上车前，司机不得不先挪开一辆停着的车。

entries.shortAnswer: 倒车入库的英文是 reverse parking，指把车向后倒入车位。在驾考中是科目二必考项，日常停车也常说 back into a parking spot。
entries.definition: reverse parking 强调倒车进入车位这一动作，多用于驾考和驾驶教学；日常口语也可说 back into a parking space。注意别与 parallel parking（侧方停车）混淆，后者指沿路边平行停靠。

examples.en: The examiner failed me because I didn't finish reverse parking within the time limit.
examples.zh: 考官判我不及格，因为我没在规定时间内完成倒车入库。

examples.en: Learning reverse parking is the hardest part of the driving test for many learners.
examples.zh: 对很多学员来说，倒车入库是驾照考试中最难的部分。

entries.shortAnswer: reverse parking 的中文意思是倒车入库，指将车倒退驶入停车位。它侧重倒入动作本身，与 parallel parking（侧方停车）不同，后者是沿路沿平行停靠。
entries.definition: reverse parking 常用于驾考和驾驶教学语境，指倒退进入车位；日常口语也说 back into a parking spot。英式英语中 reverse 指倒车，美式英语多用 back up，注意与 parallel parking 区分。

examples.en: The examiner failed me because I didn't finish reverse parking within the time limit.
examples.zh: 考官判我不及格，因为我没在规定时间内完成倒车入库。

examples.en: Learning reverse parking is the hardest part of the driving test for many learners.
examples.zh: 对很多学员来说，倒车入库是驾照考试中最难的部分。

entries.shortAnswer: 私了用英语说是 settle privately，指小事故双方私下协商解决，不报警也不走保险。
entries.definition: 私了即 settle privately，常见于轻微交通事故，双方自行协商赔偿，避免报警和保险理赔。

examples.en: The two drivers decided to settle privately after the minor scratch, avoiding a call to the traffic police.
examples.zh: 小刮蹭后，两位司机决定私了，免得叫交警。

examples.en: If you settle privately, your insurance company won't cover the repair costs later.
examples.zh: 如果你私了，保险公司之后就不会赔维修费了。

entries.shortAnswer: Settle privately 的中文意思是“私了”，即双方私下协商解决小事故或纠纷，不报警也不报保险。
entries.definition: Settle privately 指小事故中双方自行协商赔偿，不报警、不报保险。注意：正式法律语境多用 settle out of court。

examples.en: The two drivers decided to settle privately after the minor scratch, avoiding a call to the traffic police.
examples.zh: 小刮蹭后，两位司机决定私了，免得叫交警。

examples.en: If you settle privately, your insurance company won't cover the repair costs later.
examples.zh: 如果你私了，保险公司之后就不会赔维修费了。

entries.shortAnswer: 「剐蹭」的英文是 minor scrape，指车身轻微擦伤，损伤很浅，一般只伤漆面表层。
entries.definition: minor scrape 多用于网约车、顺风车场景，指停车或低速行驶时车身被蹭出的浅痕，常见搭配 a minor scrape on the bumper。

examples.en: I got a minor scrape on the rear bumper while parking in a tight spot.
examples.zh: 我在窄位停车时，后保险杠被剐蹭了一下。

examples.en: The Didi driver said it was just a minor scrape and offered to settle it privately.
examples.zh: 滴滴司机说只是剐蹭，提出私了。

entries.shortAnswer: minor scrape 的中文意思是「剐蹭」，指车身轻微擦伤，比 scratch 更轻，通常只伤漆面。
entries.definition: minor scrape 指车辆表面的浅层擦伤，常见于停车、窄路会车或网约车接单途中，常搭配 get a minor scrape。

examples.en: I got a minor scrape on the rear bumper while parking in a tight spot.
examples.zh: 我在窄位停车时，后保险杠被剐蹭了一下。

examples.en: The Didi driver said it was just a minor scrape and offered to settle it privately.
examples.zh: 滴滴司机说只是剐蹭，提出私了。

entries.shortAnswer: 「远光狗」的英文是 high-beam abuser，指滥用远光灯、晃得对向司机睁不开眼的人，语气很冲。
entries.definition: high-beam abuser 是名词短语，high-beam 指远光灯，abuser 指滥用者；中文「狗」是网络贬义后缀。

examples.en: I flashed my lights at the high-beam abuser coming the other way, but he never switched to low beams.
examples.zh: 我对迎面开来的远光狗闪了几下灯，可他一直没换近光。

examples.en: Late at night, high-beam abusers on the highway can blind oncoming drivers and cause real danger.
examples.zh: 深夜高速上的远光狗会让对向司机瞬间致盲，真的很容易出危险。

entries.shortAnswer: high-beam abuser 的中文意思是「远光狗」，指滥用远光灯、让对向司机炫目的司机，贬义吐槽。
entries.definition: high-beam abuser 是口语吐槽用语，常见搭配有 a high-beam abuser on the road；正式写作宜用 drivers who misuse high beams。

examples.en: I flashed my lights at the high-beam abuser coming the other way, but he never switched to low beams.
examples.zh: 我对迎面开来的远光狗闪了几下灯，可他一直没换近光。

examples.en: Late at night, high-beam abusers on the highway can blind oncoming drivers and cause real danger.
examples.zh: 深夜高速上的远光狗会让对向司机瞬间致盲，真的很容易出危险。
